documents.title: TRPM8 virtual screening: the essential role of target-specific, inactive-enriched machine-learning scoring functions.
meta: James, Nivya; Ballester, Pedro J
Digital discovery
documents.summary: 该文针对TRPM8离子通道建立结构基虚拟筛选基准，评估机器学习打分函数，虽涉及蛋白结构对接和ML方法，但核心是药物筛选而非蛋白质结构计算建模，且对象为离子通道，算法可部分迁移至蛋白体系。
documents.abstract: The Transient Receptor Potential Melastatin 8 (TRPM8) ion channel is an emerging therapeutic target implicated in pain, inflammation and other disorders. While structure-based virtual screening (VS) is widely used in drug discovery, the effectiveness of generic and target-specific machine-learning (ML) scoring functions (SFs) for ion channels such as TRPM8 remains to be investigated. We established the first comprehensive structure-based VS benchmark for TRPM8. This evaluates classical docking SFs, generic ML SFs and target-specific ML models retrospectively across multiple TRPM8 protein conformations and docking protocols. The evaluation revealed that generic ML rescoring at most provided modest and conformation-dependent improvements over classical docking on this target. Target-specific ML models based only on protein-ligand interaction fingerprints improved early enrichment on test sets when regression algorithms were employed. However, performance remained sensitive to protein conformation choice and chemical dissimilarity. Systematic evaluation of feature representations showed that combining structure-derived interaction features with ligand-based descriptors enhanced enrichment under selected docking tool-protein conformation combinations. Critically, presenting the learning algorithm with many more negative training instances, via inactive-enriched training, strongly reduced false positives. This also resulted in markedly improved generalization to chemically dissimilar test sets for structure-based models. By contrast, ligand-only QSAR models collapsed under the same class-imbalanced regime. Under inactive-enriched training, PLEC-based support vector regression (SVR) models achieved robust and strong VS performance, highlighting the critical role of learning the vast diversity of inactive molecules better during model training in developing predictive target-specific ML SFs for TRPM8 VS. 瞬时受体电位M8（TRPM8）离子通道是一个新兴的治疗靶点，涉及疼痛、炎症及其他疾病。尽管基于结构的虚拟筛选（VS）在药物发现中广泛应用，但通用及靶标特异性机器学习（ML）打分函数（SFs）对TRPM8等离子通道的有效性仍有待研究。我们建立了首个针对TRPM8的全面基于结构的VS基准。该基准回顾性评估了经典对接SF、通用ML SF及靶标特异性ML模型，涵盖多种TRPM8蛋白构象和对接协议。评估结果显示，通用ML重打分在该靶标上最多仅提供适度的、依赖构象的改进，优于经典对接。基于仅蛋白-配体相互作用指纹的靶标特异性ML模型，在采用回归算法时，提高了测试集上的早期富集度。然而，性能仍对蛋白构象选择和化学不相似性敏感。对特征表示的系统评估表明，将结构衍生的相互作用特征与基于配体的描述符相结合，在选定的对接工具-蛋白构象组合下增强了富集度。关键的是，通过非活性富集训练，向学习算法提供更多负训练实例，显著减少了假阳性。这也导致基于结构的模型在化学不相似测试集上的泛化能力显著提升。相比之下，仅基于配体的QSAR模型在同一类不平衡条件下崩溃。在非活性富集训练下，基于PLEC的支持向量回归（SVR）模型实现了稳健且强大的VS性能，突显了在模型训练期间更好地学习大量非活性分子多样性，对于开发预测性靶标特异性ML SF以用于TRPM8 VS的关键作用。

documents.title: High-speed atomic force microscopy of membrane proteins: From dynamic imaging to integrative structural biology.
meta: Shin, Eunji; Mount, Jonathan; Scheuring, Simon
Current opinion in structural biology
documents.summary: 该文综述高速原子力显微镜对膜蛋白动态成像及与MD模拟等整合的结构生物学应用，涉及蛋白质结构动态但以实验技术为主，计算建模仅作为辅助整合手段。
documents.abstract: High-speed atomic force microscopy (HS-AFM) enables direct, label-free visualization of membrane proteins in lipid bilayers with nanometer spatial resolution and millisecond temporal resolution. Recent studies revealed transient conformational states, dynamic oligomerization changes, and membrane-mediated organization of membrane proteins that are not readily captured by conventional structural or biophysical approaches. Advances in experimental design-including membrane reconstitution strategies, stimulus-coupled imaging, high-temporal-resolution acquisition, and computational reconstruction-have further expanded the scope of HS-AFM. When integrated with complementary techniques such as cryo-electron microscopy, molecular dynamics simulations, and single-molecule methods, HS-AFM provides a powerful and versatile tool for linking membrane protein structure, dynamics, and function in native-like environments. 高速原子力显微镜（HS-AFM）能够直接、无标记地可视化脂质双分子层中的膜蛋白，具备纳米级空间分辨率和毫秒级时间分辨率。近期研究揭示了膜蛋白的瞬态构象状态、动态寡聚化变化及膜介导的组织结构，这些现象难以通过传统结构或生物物理方法捕获。实验设计的进展——包括膜重构策略、刺激耦合成像、高时间分辨率采集及计算重建——进一步拓展了HS-AFM的应用范围。当与冷冻电子显微镜、分子动力学模拟及单分子方法等互补技术整合时，HS-AFM为在类天然环境中连接膜蛋白结构、动力学与功能提供了强大且多功能的工具。

documents.title: AASIA: A comprehensive protein structural interactome database for agricultural animals.
meta: Li, Jiajun; Yuan, Mengdi; Jiang, Linyang; Li, Dianke; Yin, Zhongtao; Zhu, Feng; Shi, Wenyu; Hou, Zhuocheng; Zhang, Ziding
Journal of advanced research
documents.summary: 该文构建了农业动物蛋白质结构互作组数据库，利用深度学习预测PPI并生成复合物结构，虽非核心方法创新，但涉及蛋白质结构计算建模，对结构互作组研究有参考价值。
documents.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Agricultural animals are essential for global food production and sustainable agriculture. Improving disease resistance and economically important traits is critical for ensuring food security. Proteome-wide protein-protein interactions (PPIs), termed as interactomes, underlie key biological processes in cells, making them critical for deciphering the genome-phenome relationship. However, species-specific PPI resources remain limited for most agricultural animals. OBJECTIVES: Motivated by the rapid development of deep learning and breakthroughs in AI-driven protein structure prediction, we attempted to develop an integrated structural interactome resource for agricultural animals. METHODS: We predicted species-specific interactomes through an integrative prediction pipeline that combines interolog mapping, domain-domain interaction inference, and deep learning. The 3D complex structures of all predicted PPIs were further generated using ESMFold. RESULTS: We established AASIA (Agricultural Animals Structural Interactome Atlas; https://aasia.zzdlab.com), a user-friendly database comprising 410,421 high-confidence PPIs and corresponding complex structures across five key species, including Anas platyrhynchos, Bos taurus, Gallus gallus, Ovis aries, and Sus scrofa. CONCLUSIONS: AASIA provides the first proteome-scale structural interactome resource for five key agricultural animals. By integrating interaction prediction with structural modeling, it enables mechanistic insight into agriculturally relevant traits and supports applications in variant interpretation, multi-omics integration, and molecular breeding. 引言：农业动物对全球粮食生产和可持续农业至关重要。提高抗病性和经济重要性状对于确保粮食安全十分关键。全蛋白质组范围内的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs），称为相互作用组（interactomes），是细胞中关键生物过程的基础，因此对于解读基因组-表型组关系具有重要意义。然而，大多数农业动物的物种特异性PPI资源仍然有限。目标：受深度学习快速发展和AI驱动的蛋白质结构预测突破的启发，我们试图为农业动物开发一个整合的结构性相互作用组资源。方法：我们通过一个整合预测流程预测了物种特异性相互作用组，该流程结合了interolog映射、结构域-结构域相互作用推断和深度学习。所有预测PPIs的三维复合物结构进一步使用ESMFold生成。结果：我们建立了AASIA（农业动物结构性相互作用组图谱；https://aasia.zzdlab.com），这是一个用户友好的数据库，包含五个关键物种的410,421个高置信度PPIs及相应的复合物结构，这些物种包括绿头鸭（Anas platyrhynchos）、家牛（Bos taurus）、原鸡（Gallus gallus）、绵羊（Ovis aries）和家猪（Sus scrofa）。结论：AASIA为五种关键农业动物提供了首个蛋白质组规模的结构性相互作用组资源。通过将相互作用预测与结构建模相结合，它能够对农业相关性状提供机制性见解，并支持在变异解读、多组学整合和分子育种中的应用。

documents.title: Computational methods for alternative proteins.
meta: Vyshnav, S; Sundararajan, Vino; Sudhakaran, Sajitha Lulu
Advances in protein chemistry and structural biology
documents.summary: 该综述系统总结了替代蛋白研发中的计算生物学方法，涵盖结构建模、分子模拟和蛋白设计等，虽以食品蛋白为对象，但方法框架对蛋白质结构计算研究有参考价值。
documents.abstract: The growing demand for sustainable food systems has accelerated research into alternative proteins derived from plant sources, microorganisms, insects, and cultured animal cells. These protein systems offer promising solutions to environmental, ethical, and nutritional challenges associated with conventional livestock production. However, designing and optimizing alternative proteins requires deep understanding of molecular structures, biochemical properties, and production processes. Computational biology has emerged as a powerful approach to address these challenges by enabling predictive modeling, data-driven protein engineering, and large-scale bioinformatic analyses. This chapter provides a comprehensive overview of computational methods applied in alternative protein research and development. Key approaches discussed include sequence-based bioinformatics, structural modeling, molecular simulations, protein design algorithms, machine learning techniques, metabolic modeling, and process simulation. The chapter further explores how these computational frameworks support discovery of novel protein sources, optimization of functional properties, and scaling of industrial production processes. Challenges and future research directions are also discussed, particularly the integration of artificial intelligence, multi-omics data, and digital twin technologies for food manufacturing. Computational technologies are expected to play a pivotal role in shaping next-generation protein foods by accelerating innovation, reducing development costs, and enabling sustainable protein production systems. 可持续食品系统日益增长的需求加速了对源自植物、微生物、昆虫及培养动物细胞的替代蛋白质的研究。这些蛋白质系统为传统畜牧业生产所带来的环境、伦理和营养挑战提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，设计和优化替代蛋白质需要深入理解分子结构、生化特性和生产过程。计算生物学已成为应对这些挑战的有力方法，通过实现预测建模、数据驱动的蛋白质工程和大规模生物信息学分析。本章全面概述了应用于替代蛋白质研究与开发的计算方法。讨论的关键方法包括基于序列的生物信息学、结构建模、分子模拟、蛋白质设计算法、机器学习技术、代谢建模和过程模拟。本章进一步探讨了这些计算框架如何支持新型蛋白质来源的发现、功能特性的优化以及工业生产过程的规模化。还讨论了挑战和未来研究方向，特别是人工智能、多组学数据和数字孪生技术在食品制造中的整合。计算技术有望通过加速创新、降低开发成本和实现可持续蛋白质生产系统，在塑造下一代蛋白质食品中发挥关键作用。

documents.title: Computational structural insights into alternative proteins: The impact of AlphaFold and AI-based prediction.
meta: Natarajan, Shiammala Periyasamy; Ramarajan, Bagavathi Lakshmi; Sivakumar, Rani; Mani, Jayaprakashvel
Advances in protein chemistry and structural biology
documents.summary: 该综述聚焦AlphaFold等AI方法在替代蛋白（植物、微生物等）结构预测中的应用，对象为蛋白质结构且方法涉及AI预测，但以应用综述为主、缺乏方法创新，故评6分。
documents.abstract: Proteins are fundamental biomolecules composed of amino acids linked by peptide bonds, forming complex macromolecules that determine cellular structure and biological function. The three-dimensional conformation of proteins plays a crucial role in defining their biochemical activity, stability, and interactions. In the emerging field of alternative proteins, such as microbial, algal, plant-based, and precision-fermented proteins, understanding structural organization is essential for improving functional properties including digestibility, nutritional value, texture, and enzymatic performance. Experimental determination of protein structures through conventional techniques remains time-consuming, technically demanding, and expensive. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence have revolutionized protein structure prediction, particularly with the development of AlphaFold by Google DeepMind. AlphaFold integrates deep learning algorithms, attention mechanisms, and evolutionary information derived from multiple sequence alignments to accurately predict spatial relationships among amino acid residues. Its performance has been validated through the Critical Assessment of Structure Prediction (CASP) competitions, demonstrating unprecedented accuracy in computational structure prediction. The application of AlphaFold provides significant opportunities for accelerating research in alternative proteins by enabling rapid structural characterization, enzyme engineering, and functional optimization of novel protein sources. This review highlights the scientific developments that led to AlphaFold, describes its architectural innovations, and discusses its potential applications in alternative protein discovery, design, and processing. Furthermore, current limitations and future perspectives in AI-assisted structural prediction for sustainable protein production are discussed. 蛋白质是由氨基酸通过肽键连接而成的基本生物分子，形成决定细胞结构和生物学功能的复杂大分子。蛋白质的三维构象在定义其生化活性、稳定性和相互作用方面起着至关重要的作用。在新兴的替代蛋白质领域，如微生物、藻类、植物基和精密发酵蛋白质，理解结构组织对于改善功能特性（包括消化性、营养价值、质地和酶学性能）至关重要。通过传统技术实验测定蛋白质结构仍然耗时、技术要求高且成本高昂。人工智能的最新进展彻底改变了蛋白质结构预测，尤其是谷歌DeepMind开发的AlphaFold。AlphaFold整合了深度学习算法、注意力机制和源自多序列比对的进化信息，以准确预测氨基酸残基之间的空间关系。其性能已通过蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP）竞赛得到验证，展示了计算结构预测中前所未有的准确性。AlphaFold的应用为加速替代蛋白质研究提供了重要机遇，能够实现快速结构表征、酶工程和新蛋白质来源的功能优化。本综述重点介绍了促成AlphaFold的科学进展，描述了其架构创新，并讨论了其在替代蛋白质发现、设计和加工中的潜在应用。此外，还讨论了当前局限性以及人工智能辅助结构预测在可持续蛋白质生产中的未来前景。

documents.title: Latent generative search unlocks de novo design of untapped biomolecular interactions at scale
meta: Didi K; Reidenbach D; Penner M; Ravichandran S; Case M; Nichols M; Swanson E; Reis A; Prescott M; Qian Y; Qian D; Yang J; Li W; Li L; Shonai D; Gay S; Basu Mallik B; Chim HY; Chen L; Atienza Juanatey M; Klein H; Rieger D; Schlegel P; Macintyre AU; Secor M; Granata D; Cha S; Cao Z; Zhou G; Geffner T; Chen X; Livne M; Zhang Z; Zhang T; Gion K; Bronstein MM; Steinegger M; Deibler K; Soderling S; Schoeder CT; Khmelinskaia A; Hollfelder F; Dallago C; Kucukbenli E; Vahdat A; Ogden P; Kreis K
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文提出潜空间生成搜索框架，利用奖励引导的推理时搜索驱动Proteina-Complexa生成模型协同设计蛋白序列与结构，实现针对极性表位和柔性配体的全新蛋白结合剂设计，直接命中蛋白质结构生成与设计核心问题，方法创新性强。
documents.abstract: De novo protein design has advanced rapidly, yet designing binders to polar, solvent-exposed epitopes and small, flexible ligands remains challenging. Such hydrated surfaces and flexible molecules, including carbohydrates, provide few of the hydrophobic contacts favoured by current methods and have largely resisted de novo binders. To address this challenge, here we introduce latent generative search for binder design, a novel framework that uses reward-guided search at inference time to steer the Proteina-Complexa generative model. The model codesigns sequence and structure - generating them together in a continuous latent space - and thereby removes the inverse-folding step on which current methods rely. In a screen of more than one million designs by multiplexed phage display, latent generative search produced more validated binders than every other method tested, its codesigned sequences surpassing post hoc redesign. It delivered high-affinity binders across therapeutic receptors, a viral attachment protein and intracellular signalling targets. Our approach also accessed previously untapped biology, generating the first de novo proteins that bind a free carbohydrate, including one that discriminates between blood-group antigens - a polar, flexible target class beyond the reach of current design methods. 从头设计蛋白质已取得快速进展，但针对极性、溶剂暴露表位以及小型柔性配体的结合剂设计仍具挑战性。此类水合表面和柔性分子（包括碳水化合物）提供的疏水接触较少，而当前方法偏好这些接触，因此大多难以生成从头结合剂。为应对这一挑战，我们在此引入用于结合剂设计的潜在生成搜索（latent generative search），这是一种新颖框架，在推理时利用奖励引导搜索来引导Proteina-Complexa生成模型。该模型共同设计序列和结构——在连续潜在空间中同时生成它们——从而消除了当前方法所依赖的逆折叠步骤。在超过一百万个设计的多重噬菌体展示筛选实验中，潜在生成搜索产生的验证结合剂数量超过所有其他测试方法，其共同设计的序列优于事后重设计。它提供了针对治疗性受体、病毒附着蛋白和细胞内信号靶点的高亲和力结合剂。我们的方法还触及了此前未开发的生物学领域，生成了首个结合游离碳水化合物的从头蛋白质，其中包括一种能区分血型抗原的结合剂——这是一个极性、柔性的靶标类别，超出了当前设计方法的能力范围。

documents.title: Controlled Blood-Brain Barrier Modulation by a High-Affinity Claudin-5 Peptide Binder
meta: Berselli A; Trevisani M; Alberini G; Pastore A; Di Fonzo A; Armirotti A; Castagnola V; Maragliano L; Benfenati F
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文结合生成式蛋白设计与原子模拟，设计出高亲和力靶向Claudin-5的肽段以调控血脑屏障通透性，核心涉及蛋白-肽结合的结构计算建模与设计，与蛋白质结构计算课题高度相关。
documents.abstract: The blood-brain barrier (BBB) is a specialized interface that tightly regulates the exchange of molecules between the bloodstream and the brain. Its barrier function relies on a monolayer of brain endothelial cells sealed by tight junctions (TJs) that restrict paracellular flux through claudin-5 (CLDN5) multimeric complexes. To improve the delivery of nutrients and drugs to the brain, CLDN5-competitive peptides are promising carriers for creating size-controlled, temporary openings in the paracellular pathway. Here, we combine generative protein design and atomistic simulations to design ST9, a peptide with high nanomolar affinity for CLDN5. Compared with f1-C5C2, a CLDN5-binding peptide that we previously reported, ST9 induces a rapid, transient, size-controlled, and fully reversible increase in paracellular permeability, without altering CLDN5 expression or the proteomic profile of brain endothelial cells, indicating distinct mechanisms of TJ destabilization. This work provides a promising approach for developing next-generation BBB-opening agents to effectively treat neurological diseases. 血脑屏障（blood-brain barrier, BBB）是一种特化的界面，严格调控血液与大脑之间分子的交换。其屏障功能依赖于由紧密连接（tight junctions, TJs）密封的脑内皮细胞单层，这些紧密连接通过claudin-5（CLDN5）多聚体复合物限制旁细胞通量。为了改善营养物质和药物向大脑的递送，CLDN5竞争性肽作为有前景的载体，可用于在旁细胞通路中产生尺寸可控的临时开口。在此，我们结合生成式蛋白质设计和原子级模拟，设计了ST9，一种对CLDN5具有高纳摩尔亲和力的肽。与我们先前报道的CLDN5结合肽f1-C5C2相比，ST9诱导旁细胞通透性快速、瞬时、尺寸可控且完全可逆的增加，而不改变CLDN5表达或脑内皮细胞的蛋白质组谱，表明其具有不同的TJ失稳机制。这项工作为开发下一代BBB开放剂以有效治疗神经系统疾病提供了一种有前景的方法。

documents.title: A Unified 3D Generative Model for Synthesizable Structure-Based Drug Design
meta: Ilia Igashov; Arne Schneuing; Adrian W. Dobbelstein; Irina Morozova; Rebecca M. Neeser; Kara Zielinski; Luciano Andres Abriata; Aaron S. Petruzzella; David R. Pavel Iosub; Olivia Gampp; Artem Y. Lyubimov; Evgenia Elizarova; Isabella Ferrara; Pedro M. F. Sousa; Ana R. Lemos; Fabio Testori; Pierre A. Miranda Herrera; Laurin Kanis; Joseph Schmidt; Mac Kevin E. Braza; Rommie E. Amaro; Nicolas Thoma; Davide M. Ferraris; Roland Riek; James S. Fraser; Philippe Schwaller; Michael Bronstein; Bruno Correia
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文提出统一3D生成模型LDDM用于基于结构的药物设计，虽以配体小分子为核心对象，但其生成、对接和可编程设计框架可迁移至蛋白质结构计算，对蛋白-配体复合物建模有借鉴价值。
documents.abstract: Traditional screening-based drug discovery is inherently limited by the astronomical scale of the chemical space. Generative modelling offers a compelling alternative to the classical search paradigm and enables rational, bottom-up design of novel and target-specific small molecules. However, its impact has been hampered by challenges in synthetic accessibility of the designed compounds and lack of large-scale experimental validation. Here, we introduce LDDM (Large Drug Discovery Model), a generative framework that supports a range of drug discovery tasks, including constrained and unconstrained docking, fragment linking and growing, and de novo design. We further introduce a programmable design algorithm that enables accurate design of synthetically accessible compounds satisfying various fine-grained objectives. We experimentally validated the designed or optimised ligands for five therapeutically relevant protein targets. In all cases, LDDM achieved high success rates, allowing us to identify molecules with confirmed binding affinity while synthesizing only a small number of generated compounds. The best designs were structurally characterised through NMR spectroscopy and X-ray crystallography, demonstrating high prediction accuracy. Overall, LDDM provides a scalable and flexible platform for the rapid and tailored design of small molecules and non-natural peptides for therapeutic applications. 基于传统筛选的药物发现本质上受限于化学空间的巨大规模。生成式建模为经典搜索范式提供了一种引人注目的替代方案，并能够实现理性、自下而上地设计新型且靶点特异的小分子。然而，其影响力一直受到设计化合物合成可及性挑战以及缺乏大规模实验验证的阻碍。在此，我们引入了LDDM（大型药物发现模型），这是一个生成式框架，支持多种药物发现任务，包括受限和非受限对接、片段连接与生长，以及从头设计。我们进一步提出了一种可编程设计算法，能够精确设计满足各种细粒度目标的合成可及化合物。我们针对五个治疗相关的蛋白质靶点，对设计或优化的配体进行了实验验证。在所有情况下，LDDM均实现了高成功率，使我们能够在仅合成少量生成化合物的同时，识别出具有确认结合亲和力的分子。最佳设计通过核磁共振波谱和X射线晶体学进行了结构表征，展示了高预测准确性。总体而言，LDDM为治疗应用中的小分子和非天然肽的快速定制设计提供了一个可扩展且灵活的平台。

documents.title: EM3DFold: accurate de novo protein and nucleic acid model building for cryo-EM maps using language model-powered deep learning
meta: Tao Li; Hong Cao; Sheng-You Huang
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文提出EM3DFold，利用语言模型驱动的三轨注意力网络从冷冻电镜密度图自动构建蛋白质和核酸的原子模型，属于蛋白质结构预测与建模的核心计算研究，方法创新且性能领先。
documents.abstract: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become one of the most powerful techniques for macromolecular structure determination. However, accurate model building from cryo-EM maps remains challenging, particularly for nucleic acids. Here, we present EM3DFold, a unified de novo model-building framework for accurate structure determination of proteins, nucleic acids, and protein-nucleic acid complexes from cryo-EM maps using a density-aware, large language model-powered three-track attention (TTA) network. The TTA network effectively integrates sequence, density, and structural information to enable accurate all-atom model building. EM3DFold was extensively evaluated on independent benchmarks of 298 experimental cryo-EM maps at < 4.0 Å resolutions, and achieves an unprecedentedly high median accuracy of 75% completeness (88% coverage and 94% sequence accuracy) for 178 nucleic acid maps, 90% completeness (95% coverage and 96% sequence accuracy) for 124 protein-nucleic acid complexes, and 95% completeness (97% coverage and 98% sequence accuracy) for 120 protein-only targets, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art methods including ModelAngelo, EM2NA, CryoREAD, and EMProt. In addition, EM3DFold also produces models with superior model-to-map fit and stereochemical quality, providing a robust and reliable solution for automated cryo-EM model building. The EM3DFold package is freely available at https://github.com/huang-laboratory/EM3DFold. 冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）已成为大分子结构测定中最强大的技术之一。然而，从冷冻电镜图谱中准确构建模型仍具挑战性，尤其是对于核酸。在此，我们提出EM3DFold，一个统一的从头模型构建框架，利用密度感知、大语言模型驱动的三轨注意力（TTA）网络，从冷冻电镜图谱中准确测定蛋白质、核酸及蛋白质-核酸复合物的结构。TTA网络有效整合序列、密度和结构信息，实现准确的全原子模型构建。EM3DFold在298个分辨率<4.0 Å的实验冷冻电镜图谱的独立基准上进行了广泛评估，并在178个核酸图谱中实现了前所未有的75%完整度（88%覆盖率和94%序列准确率）的中位准确度，在124个蛋白质-核酸复合物中达到90%完整度（95%覆盖率和96%序列准确率），在120个纯蛋白质靶标中达到95%完整度（97%覆盖率和98%序列准确率），显著优于包括ModelAngelo、EM2NA、CryoREAD和EMProt在内的最先进方法。此外，EM3DFold还生成具有优异模型-图谱拟合度和立体化学质量的模型，为自动化冷冻电镜模型构建提供了稳健可靠的解决方案。EM3DFold软件包可在https://github.com/huang-laboratory/EM3DFold免费获取。

documents.title: Conditional Generation And Inpainting Of Non-coding RNA Sequences With Masked Discrete Diffusion
meta: Upadhyay U; Dai C; Herold J; Sato K; Schug A
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文提出RNA-MDLM，用掩码离散扩散模型对非编码RNA进行条件生成与修复，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其生成与修复框架及条件控制方法可迁移至蛋白质结构/序列设计，具有借鉴价值。
documents.abstract:
Design:

ing functional non-coding RNA (ncRNA) is fundamental to synthetic biology and RNA therapeutics, yet generative modelling for ncRNA has received far less attention than protein design. We present RNA-MDLM, a framework that extends Masked Discrete Language Models (MDLM) to the conditional generation and inpainting of ncRNA. We make two additions: first, conditioning on RNA-type representations from a pretrained RNA language model, and second, a modified classifier-free guidance scheme (Mod-CFG) that interpolates among conditional, unconditional, and random-sequence probabilities for better control. We also introduce REPAINT GAMES, a benchmark of seven structured masking tasks to probe a model's performance on sequence patterns, structural motifs, and base-pairing per RNA type. Our model is trained on 4.6 million ncRNA sequences spanning six evaluable classes. It produces sequences whose composition and folding statistics closely match natural RNAs. Through extensive ablation studies, we find that the embedding-conditioned model achieves the best balance of structural fidelity, biological novelty, and inpainting accuracy, and its class label steers generation far more strongly than a plain label baseline. We further show that a model trained on a smaller, class-balanced subset can appear more realistic mainly by copying abundant natural sequences rather than learning their rules. We also benchmark against a masked-diffusion model and a family-specific VAE on ribozyme families, and find that a type-conditioned model like ours and a per-family model are solving different tasks, which must be accounted for in a fair comparison. We will release the code and the trained models.

设计：

功能性非编码RNA（ncRNA）的设计是合成生物学和RNA治疗学的基础，然而针对ncRNA的生成建模所受到的关注远少于蛋白质设计。我们提出了RNA-MDLM，一个将掩码离散语言模型（MDLM）扩展到ncRNA的条件生成和修复的框架。我们做了两项改进：首先，基于预训练的RNA语言模型中的RNA类型表示进行条件化；其次，采用一种改进的无分类器引导方案（Mod-CFG），在条件、无条件及随机序列概率之间进行插值，以实现更好的控制。我们还引入了REPAINT GAMES，一个包含七项结构化掩码任务的基准测试，用于评估模型在序列模式、结构基序和碱基配对方面按RNA类型的表现。我们的模型在覆盖六个可评估类别的460万个ncRNA序列上进行了训练。它生成的序列在组成和折叠统计上与天然RNA高度接近。通过广泛的消融研究，我们发现嵌入条件化模型在结构保真度、生物新颖性和修复准确性方面达到了最佳平衡，且其类别标签对生成的引导作用远强于普通标签基线。我们进一步表明，在较小、类别平衡的子集上训练的模型可能主要通过复制丰富的天然序列而非学习其规则来显得更真实。我们还针对核酶家族，将我们的模型与掩码扩散模型和家族特异性VAE进行了基准比较，发现像我们这样的类型条件化模型和逐家族模型在解决不同任务，这在公平比较中必须予以考虑。我们将发布代码和训练好的模型。

documents.title: Computational Design of RNA Aptamers Targeting Oncogenic miR-10b Using T‑SELEX and Molecular Dynamics-Based Stability Metrics.
meta: Mokgopa, Kabelo Phuti; Lobb, Kevin A; Tshiwawa, Tendamudzimu
ACS omega
documents.summary: 该文用T-SELEX框架结合MD模拟和MM-GBSA计算设计靶向miR-10b的RNA适配体，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其结构预测、对接和MD稳定性评估的计算流程可迁移至蛋白质结构计算，故给予中档评分。
documents.abstract: Aptamers are versatile single-stranded nucleic acids with high specificity and stability, making them ideal for targeting challenging biomolecules. Their structural flexibility enables selective recognition of nonprotein targets such as microRNAs (miRNAs). Among these, miR-10b plays a pivotal role in cancer progression and metastasis through its oncogenic 5p and 3p arms. We propose designing aptamers specifically targeting miR-10b through a computational framework to enable precise and efficient regulation of aberrant miRNA activity in cancer. Herein, we introduce a multiscale computational workflow built on the T_SELEX framework, integrating sequence generation, folding of secondary and tertiary structure prediction, then virtual screening, quantum mechanical (QM) calculations, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and MM-GBSA analysis for the design and evaluation of RNA aptamer candidates targeting pre-miR-10b and its mature 5p and 3p arms. This robust workflow enables large-scale identification and structural evaluation of computationally promising RNA aptamer candidates for RNA-targeted drug discovery. In this study, a library of 1100 22-mer aptamers was virtually screened, with heatmap and interaction energy analyses revealing strong affinities toward hsa-miR-25-5p. Molecular docking identified aptamer557 as the top binder to miR-10b-3p with -545.96 docking score and aptamer899 as the best for miR-10b-5p with -482.55 docking score. QM single-point calculations assessed electronic stability via total molecular energy and the HOMO-LUMO gaps, showing model-dependent variations. MD simulations incorporated novel stability metrics combining RMSD area integration and changepoint detection, alongside hydrogen bonding, RMSF, and radius of gyration analyses. The miR-10b-3p complexes exhibited lower RMSF and RMSD values with more persistent hydrogen bonds, reflecting stronger and more stable interactions than 5p complexes. Interestingly, despite both the aptamer and target miRNA adopting folded secondary and tertiary structures, partial Watson-Crick interactions were observed during both docking and molecular dynamics simulations, particularly at accessible loop and terminal regions, suggesting a hybrid binding mechanism involving localized base pairing together with structure-dependent structural recognition. MM-GBSA binding energy analysis further supported these findings, confirming that our T-SELEX-guided in silico strategy identifies computationally promising aptamer-like candidates and provides a robust framework for the rational design of RNA-targeting therapeutics. 适配体（aptamer）是一类多功能的单链核酸，具有高特异性和稳定性，使其成为靶向具有挑战性的生物分子的理想工具。其结构灵活性使其能够选择性识别非蛋白质靶标，如微小RNA（microRNA, miRNA）。其中，miR-10b通过其致癌性5p和3p臂在癌症进展和转移中发挥关键作用。我们提出通过计算框架设计特异性靶向miR-10b的适配体，以实现对癌症中异常miRNA活性的精确高效调控。在此，我们介绍一种基于T_SELEX框架构建的多尺度计算工作流程，整合序列生成、二级和三级结构预测的折叠、虚拟筛选、量子力学（quantum mechanical, QM）计算、分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟以及MM-GBSA分析，用于设计和评估靶向pre-miR-10b及其成熟5p和3p臂的RNA适配体候选物。这一稳健的工作流程能够实现大规模识别和结构评估计算上具有前景的RNA适配体候选物，从而推动RNA靶向药物发现。在本研究中，对1100个22-mer适配体文库进行了虚拟筛选，热图和相互作用能分析显示其与hsa-miR-25-5p具有强亲和力。分子对接鉴定出适配体557为miR-10b-3p的最佳结合物，对接得分为-545.96，适配体899为miR-10b-5p的最佳结合物，对接得分为-482.55。QM单点计算通过总分子能和HOMO-LUMO能隙评估电子稳定性，显示出模型依赖性差异。MD模拟引入了结合RMSD面积积分和变点检测的新型稳定性指标，同时进行了氢键、RMSF和回旋半径分析。miR-10b-3p复合物表现出较低的RMSF和RMSD值，并具有更持久的氢键，反映出比5p复合物更强、更稳定的相互作用。有趣的是，尽管适配体和靶标miRNA均采用折叠的二级和三级结构，但在对接和分子动力学模拟过程中均观察到部分Watson-Crick相互作用，特别是在可及的环区和末端区域，这表明存在一种涉及局部碱基配对和结构依赖性识别的混合结合机制。MM-GBSA结合能分析进一步支持了这些发现，证实我们基于T-SELEX引导的计算机模拟策略能够识别计算上具有前景的适配体样候选物，并为RNA靶向治疗药物的合理设计提供了稳健框架。

documents.title: Prospecting the protein design landscape.
meta: Riccabona, Jakob R; Stonig, Katharina T; Meiler, Jens; Schoeder, Clara T; Fernandez-Quintero, Monica L
FEBS letters
documents.summary: 该综述概述了深度学习驱动的蛋白质设计流程，并强调集成方法提升设计成功率，虽为综述但紧扣蛋白质结构设计核心问题，方法上涉及生成式AI，具有参考价值。
documents.abstract: Generative AI has driven remarkable breakthroughs in protein design, enabling the rapid, computationally guided creation of high-affinity binders against diverse targets. While remarkable experimental success has been demonstrated, the confidence metrics used to filter and evaluate designs remain optimized for static protein interfaces and can fail when applied to underrepresented or conformationally complex targets. In this review, we outline the current landscape of deep learning-driven protein design pipelines, discuss tailored applications in peptide, small molecule, binder, vaccine, and antibody design, and argue that the integration of ensemble-based methods represents a promising avenue for improving design success rates. Beyond single target binder design, we further highlight emerging strategies that expand the functional scope of designed proteins, including fold-switching scaffolds and molecular glues realized through engineered cyclic peptides, which enable context-dependent control of protein-protein interaction networks. Together, these advances position de novo protein design as a broadly applicable technology platform at the intersection of structural biology, biophysics, and molecular medicine. 生成式人工智能推动了蛋白质设计的显著突破，能够快速、计算引导地创建针对多种靶标的高亲和力结合剂。尽管已展示出显著的实验成功，但用于筛选和评估设计的置信度指标仍针对静态蛋白质界面进行优化，在应用于代表性不足或构象复杂的靶标时可能失效。在本综述中，我们概述了当前深度学习驱动的蛋白质设计流程的格局，讨论了在肽、小分子、结合剂、疫苗和抗体设计中的定制应用，并主张集成基于集合的方法代表了一种提高设计成功率的可行途径。超越单一靶标结合剂设计，我们进一步强调了扩展设计蛋白质功能范围的新兴策略，包括通过工程化环肽实现的折叠转换支架和分子胶，这些策略能够实现蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络的上下文依赖性控制。总体而言，这些进展将从头蛋白质设计定位为结构生物学、生物物理学和分子医学交叉领域的一项广泛应用的技术平台。

documents.title: Linear antibody epitope prediction using AlphaFold2.
meta: DeRoo, Jacob; Terry, James S; Zhao, Ning; Stasevich, Timothy J; Snow, Christopher; Geiss, Brian J
eLife
documents.summary: 该文开发了基于AlphaFold2的PAbFold流程，通过预测抗体-线性肽复合物结构来预测线性抗体表位，属于蛋白质结构预测在抗体表位识别上的应用，方法创新且经实验验证。
documents.abstract: Defining the binding epitopes of antibodies is essential for understanding how they bind to their antigens and perform their molecular functions. However, while determining linear epitopes of monoclonal antibodies can be accomplished utilizing well-established empirical procedures, these approaches are generally labor- and time-intensive, and costly. To take advantage of the recent advances in protein structure prediction algorithms available to the scientific community, we developed a calculation pipeline based on the localColabFold implementation of AlphaFold2 that can predict linear antibody epitopes by predicting the structure of the complex between antibody heavy and light chains and target peptide sequences derived from antigens. We found that this AlphaFold2 pipeline, which we call PAbFold, was able to accurately flag known epitope sequences for several well-known antibody targets (HA/Myc) when the target sequence was broken into small overlapping linear peptides and antibody complementarity determining regions were grafted onto several different antibody framework regions in the single-chain antibody fragment format. To determine if this pipeline was able to identify the epitope of a novel antibody with no structural information publicly available, we determined the epitope of a novel anti-SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid-targeted antibody using our method and then experimentally validated our computational results using peptide competition ELISA assays. These results indicate that the AlphaFold2-based PAbFold pipeline we developed is capable of accurately identifying linear antibody epitopes in a short time using just antibody and target protein sequences. This emergent capability of the method is sensitive to methodological details such as peptide length, AlphaFold2 neural network versions, and multiple-sequence alignment databases. PAbFold is available at https://github.com/jbderoo/PAbFold. 定义抗体的结合表位对于理解其如何与抗原结合并执行分子功能至关重要。然而，虽然利用成熟的经验性程序可以完成单克隆抗体线性表位的测定，但这些方法通常劳动密集、耗时且成本高昂。为了利用科学界可用的蛋白质结构预测算法的最新进展，我们开发了一个基于AlphaFold2的localColabFold实现的计算流程，通过预测抗体重链和轻链与源自抗原的靶标肽段序列之间的复合物结构，来预测线性抗体表位。我们发现，这个我们称为PAbFold的AlphaFold2流程，在将靶标序列分解为小的重叠线性肽段，并将抗体互补决定区移植到单链抗体片段格式中的几种不同抗体框架区上时，能够准确标记多个已知抗体靶标（HA/Myc）的已知表位序列。为了确定该流程是否能识别出无公开结构信息的新型抗体的表位，我们使用我们的方法确定了一种新型抗SARS-CoV-2核衣壳靶向抗体的表位，并通过肽竞争ELISA实验验证了我们的计算结果。这些结果表明，我们开发的基于AlphaFold2的PAbFold流程能够仅使用抗体和靶蛋白序列，在短时间内准确识别线性抗体表位。该方法的这种新兴能力对方法学细节敏感，如肽段长度、AlphaFold2神经网络版本和多序列比对数据库。PAbFold可在https://github.com/jbderoo/PAbFold获取。

documents.title: Integrative AI-assisted modeling suggests CPPF binding at a composite [Formula: see text]/[Formula: see text]-tubulin interface pocket dominated by [Formula: see text]-tubulin contacts.
meta: Yang, Jixin; Liang, Lisha; Zhu, Dengchao; Yin, Xuzhe; Feng, Yizhuo; Tang, Shaojun; Li, Muzi
PLoS computational biology
documents.summary: 该文利用Protenix、RFAA、Umol等AI结构预测工具和MD模拟，研究抗癌药物CPPF与微管蛋白α/β异二聚体的结合模式，属于蛋白质-配体相互作用的结构计算建模，方法创新且直接命中蛋白质结构计算课题。
documents.abstract: Microtubules are dynamic cytoskeletal polymers assembled from alpha/beta-tubulin heterodimers. Microtubules are validated targets for novel therapeutic drugs, yet therapeutic efficacy targeting them is often compromised by multidrug resistance (MDR). 5-(3-chlorophenyl)-N-(3-pyridinyl)-2-furamide (CPPF) is a novel microtubule-targeting anticancer agent which was found to disrupt microtubule growth in cells and inhibit tubulin polymerization in vitro. CPPF could suppress the growth of multidrug-resistant cell lines and demonstrate anti-tumor efficacy in animal models. However, the fundamental mechanism of how CPPF disrupts microtubule assembly remains unclear. To investigate this, we performed structure prediction using Protenix, RoseTTAFold All-Atom (RFAA) and Umol, as well as molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, using the human alpha/beta-tubulin heterodimer (PDB ID: 5IJ0) for analyzing the interaction between CPPF and tubulin. Our results showed that CPPF binds at the alpha/beta interface with dominant contributions from beta-tubulin residues, particularly VAL236 and LEU253. In isolated-monomer comparisons, beta-tubulin exhibited more favorable binding energetics and deeper, broader free-energy minima than alpha-tubulin. Supplementary simulations on the alternative beta-tubulin conformational state (PDB: 6E7B; straight microtubule-lattice) indicated that CPPF binding is preserved across the two major beta-tubulin conformations, with comparable MM-PBSA binding free energies. Taken together, these findings establish a plausible binding mode for CPPF at the alpha/beta-tubulin interface, providing a structural hypothesis for understanding its anticancer potential against multidrug-resistant cancers. Experimental validation through binding assays or crystallography is warranted to further substantiate these computational insights. 微管是由α/β-微管蛋白异二聚体组装而成的动态细胞骨架聚合物。微管是新型治疗药物的有效靶点，然而针对其的治疗效果常因多药耐药性（MDR）而受损。5-(3-氯苯基)-N-(3-吡啶基)-2-呋喃甲酰胺（CPPF）是一种新型微管靶向抗癌剂，被发现能在细胞中破坏微管生长，并在体外抑制微管蛋白聚合。CPPF能抑制多药耐药细胞系的生长，并在动物模型中显示出抗肿瘤功效。然而，CPPF如何破坏微管组装的基本机制仍不清楚。为探究此问题，我们使用Protenix、RoseTTAFold All-Atom (RFAA)和Umol进行结构预测，并采用分子动力学（MD）模拟，利用人α/β-微管蛋白异二聚体（PDB ID: 5IJ0）分析CPPF与微管蛋白之间的相互作用。结果表明，CPPF结合于α/β界面，主要贡献来自β-微管蛋白残基，特别是VAL236和LEU253。在分离单体比较中，β-微管蛋白表现出比α-微管蛋白更有利的结合能量学特征，以及更深、更宽的自由能最小值。对替代β-微管蛋白构象状态（PDB: 6E7B；直微管晶格）的补充模拟表明，CPPF结合在两种主要β-微管蛋白构象中均得以保留，且MM-PBSA结合自由能相当。综合来看，这些发现为CPPF在α/β-微管蛋白界面的结合模式提供了合理依据，为理解其针对多药耐药癌症的抗癌潜力提供了结构假说。通过结合实验或晶体学进行实验验证，对于进一步证实这些计算见解是必要的。

documents.title: Anagrelide remodels the PDE3A-SLFN12 interactome to associate with translation initiation machinery in cancer cell lines.
meta: Salmikangas, Sami; Lindholm, Iina; Sultana, Nasrin; Merikoski, Nanna; Toivanen, Kirsi; Liu, Xiaonan; Varjosalo, Markku; Bohling, Tom; Vesterinen, Tiina; Sihto, Harri
Molecular & cellular proteomics : MCP
documents.summary: 该文通过邻近标记和AlphaFold建模研究药物诱导的PDE3A-SLFN12复合物与翻译起始机器的相互作用，虽涉及蛋白复合物结构建模，但核心是细胞信号网络而非蛋白质结构计算问题。
documents.abstract: Phosphodiesterase 3A (PDE3A) modulators such as anagrelide induce complex formation between PDE3A and Schlafen 12 (SLFN12), selectively killing cancer cells that co-express both proteins. As PDE3A forms isoform- and cell type-specific signalosome complexes across multiple subcellular compartments, the effects of its modulation are expected to depend strongly on the surrounding protein interaction network. However, despite considerable pre-clinical and early clinical interest in PDE3A modulators, the cellular context in which these compounds act has remained poorly characterized. Using proximity-dependent biotinylation in two human cancer cell lines (SA-4, liposarcoma; HeLa, cervical adenocarcinoma), we mapped the interactomes of PDE3A, SLFN12, and the anagrelide-induced PDE3A-SLFN12 complex. Anagrelide induced 259 high-confidence interactions, most notably with ribosomal proteins and translation initiation factors, while suppressing 877 interactions, most prominently those associated with the proteasome, protein folding, and the ER membrane. Interactions were selectively induced with peripheral eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 (eIF3) subunits eIF3A and eIF3B, while interactions with core eIF3 subunits eIF3H, eIF3L, and eIF3M were suppressed. These findings were validated by native co-immunoprecipitation across three cancer cell lines, and multiplex immunofluorescence confirmed accumulation and ribosomal redistribution of both PDE3A and SLFN12 following anagrelide treatment. AlphaFold modeling of the PDE3A-SLFN12 complex with a partial 43S pre-initiation complex predicted binding near eIF3B and the eIF2alphabetagamma-tRNA ternary complex at the mRNA entry channel. By mapping the interactomes surrounding the drug-induced complex, our study provides important mechanistic context for how PDE3A modulators act within the cell. In our proposed model, anagrelide remodels the interactome of the PDE3A-SLFN12 complex, which relocalizes and accumulates near the mRNA entry channel of the 43S pre-initiation complex. 磷酸二酯酶3A（PDE3A）调节剂如阿那格雷（anagrelide）诱导PDE3A与Schlafen 12（SLFN12）之间形成复合物，选择性杀死共表达这两种蛋白的癌细胞。由于PDE3A在多个亚细胞区室中形成异构体特异性和细胞类型特异性的信号体复合物，其调节效应预计强烈依赖于周围的蛋白质相互作用网络。然而，尽管PDE3A调节剂在临床前和早期临床研究中引起了相当大的兴趣，这些化合物作用的细胞环境仍未被充分表征。利用两种人癌细胞系（SA-4，脂肪肉瘤；HeLa，宫颈腺癌）中的邻近依赖性生物素化标记，我们绘制了PDE3A、SLFN12以及阿那格雷诱导的PDE3A-SLFN12复合物的相互作用组图谱。阿那格雷诱导了259个高置信度相互作用，最显著的是与核糖体蛋白和翻译起始因子相关的相互作用，同时抑制了877个相互作用，其中最突出的是与蛋白酶体、蛋白质折叠和内质网膜相关的相互作用。相互作用被选择性诱导与外周真核翻译起始因子3（eIF3）亚基eIF3A和eIF3B，而核心eIF3亚基eIF3H、eIF3L和eIF3M的相互作用则被抑制。这些发现通过三种癌细胞系中的天然共免疫沉淀得到验证，多重免疫荧光确认了阿那格雷处理后PDE3A和SLFN12的积累及核糖体重新分布。对PDE3A-SLFN12复合物与部分43S前起始复合物的AlphaFold建模预测，其结合位点位于eIF3B和eIF2alphabetagamma-tRNA三元复合物附近的mRNA入口通道。通过绘制药物诱导复合物周围的相互作用组图谱，我们的研究为PDE3A调节剂如何在细胞内发挥作用提供了重要的机制背景。在我们提出的模型中，阿那格雷重塑了PDE3A-SLFN12复合物的相互作用组，该复合物重新定位并在43S前起始复合物的mRNA入口通道附近积累。

documents.title: RNAbridge: a database of extended and non-canonical helices
meta: Zakrzewski D; Antczak M; Zok T
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文构建RNA非经典螺旋结构数据库，虽涉及结构计算分析，但对象为RNA而非蛋白质，且主要贡献是数据库资源而非可迁移的算法框架，与蛋白质结构计算课题关联较弱。
documents.abstract: RNA function is dictated by 3D architecture. Although 2D structural models based on canonical Watson-Crick base pairs are widely used, they often fail to capture the non-canonical interactions, tertiary contacts, and coaxial stacking important for biological activity. We have developed RNAbridge, a comprehensive database and web application that systematically identifies, quantifies, and visualizes extended non-canonical helices and multi-way junctions. Using a geometry- and stacking-based pipeline, we analyzed the Protein Data Bank and compiled a catalog of 135,541 structural motifs. RNAbridge includes a user-friendly interface with interactive filters, synchronized 2D and 3D visualizations, and detailed structural data, including helical bend angles and stacking paths. By connecting simplified 2D topologies with complex 3D structures, RNAbridge serves as a valuable resource for structural biologists and lays the foundation for future machine learning applications in RNA structure prediction. The database, available at https://rnabridge.cs.put.poznan.pl/, is automatically updated once a week. RNA功能由三维结构决定。尽管基于经典Watson-Crick碱基配对的二维结构模型被广泛使用，但它们往往无法捕捉对生物活性至关重要的非经典相互作用、三级接触和共轴堆叠。我们开发了RNAbridge，一个综合性的数据库和网络应用程序，能够系统地识别、量化和可视化扩展的非经典螺旋和多路连接。利用基于几何和堆叠的分析流程，我们分析了蛋白质数据银行（Protein Data Bank），并编制了包含135,541个结构基序的目录。RNAbridge提供用户友好的界面，包括交互式过滤器、同步的二维和三维可视化，以及详细的结构数据，如螺旋弯曲角度和堆叠路径。通过将简化的二维拓扑结构与复杂的三维结构相连接，RNAbridge为结构生物学家提供了宝贵的资源，并为未来RNA结构预测中的机器学习应用奠定了基础。该数据库可在https://rnabridge.cs.put.poznan.pl/访问，每周自动更新一次。

documents.title: Genolator enables protein function interpretation using a multimodal large language model fusing genomic and structural interpretation with natural language interaction.
meta: Danner, Martin; Islam, Tanhim; Begemann, Matthias; Kraft, Florian; Elbracht, Miriam; Kurth, Ingo; Krause, Jeremias
Genome biology
documents.summary: 该文开发了融合DNA、氨基酸序列和蛋白质结构嵌入的多模态大语言模型Genolator，用于回答蛋白质功能相关问题，虽以蛋白质结构为输入之一并涉及结构信息整合，但核心问题是功能注释而非结构预测/采样/生成/对接等结构计算建模，方法上属AI应用但缺乏结构层面的方法创新。
documents.abstract: BACKGROUND: Decoding the genetic code to unveil its genome functionality is a monumental task which would greatly advance the understanding of disease mechanisms and development of targeted treatments. Although large language models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing across diverse domains, translating the complex language of DNA into human-readable form remains challenging due to genomic data complexity and unexplored regions of the human genome. Current language models either are capable of processing natural language or the genomic code. Models fusing both aspects are largely lacking. RESULTS: Here we present Genolator, a multimodal large language model that integrates embeddings from DNA sequences, amino acid sequences, and protein structures with natural language queries. Fine-tuned on over 365,000 question-answer pairs generated using abstracted Gene-Ontology (GO) terms, Genolator effectively answers queries regarding protein subcellular localization, molecular function, and biological processes. Evaluation demonstrates high accuracy in confirming or denying protein function associations, outperforming baseline models such as openly available allrounder LLMs like GPT 4.1 as well as smaller domain-specific models integrating knowledge from a protein structure transformer. Explorations of Genolator's hidden states unveil a biologically and linguistically plausible organization of its learned representations. Analysis of the attention heads of the underlying language model and an ablation study provide evidence for a benefit of the multi-modal approach. CONCLUSION: Genolator enhances accessibility to genomic information by enabling natural language interaction with protein data, facilitating biological discovery, and clinical research. It represents a step towards bridging genomic code and human language through the integration of a multimodal LLM. 背景：解码遗传密码以揭示其基因组功能是一项艰巨的任务，将极大推进对疾病机制的理解和靶向治疗的发展。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）已在多个领域变革了自然语言处理，但由于基因组数据的复杂性和人类基因组中未探索的区域，将DNA的复杂语言翻译成人类可读形式仍具挑战性。当前的语言模型要么能处理自然语言，要么能处理基因组编码，融合这两方面的模型大多缺失。结果：在此，我们提出Genolator，一种多模态大型语言模型，将DNA序列、氨基酸序列和蛋白质结构的嵌入与自然语言查询整合。基于使用抽象化基因本体（Gene-Ontology, GO）术语生成的超过365,000个问答对进行微调，Genolator有效回答关于蛋白质亚细胞定位、分子功能和生物过程的查询。评估显示其在确认或否定蛋白质功能关联方面具有高准确性，优于基线模型，如公开可用的全能型LLM（如GPT 4.1）以及整合蛋白质结构变换器知识的小型领域特定模型。对Genolator隐藏状态的探索揭示了其学习表示在生物学和语言学上合理的组织。对底层语言模型注意力头的分析和消融研究提供了多模态方法益处的证据。结论：Genolator通过实现与蛋白质数据的自然语言交互，增强了对基因组信息的可访问性，促进了生物发现和临床研究。它代表了通过整合多模态LLM桥接基因组编码与人类语言的一步。

documents.title: MiLaSol: modeling protein solubility by mixing up multiple protein language models.
meta: Lou, Weiwei; Erden, Mert; Cowen, Lenore
Bioinformatics advances
documents.summary: 该文利用多种蛋白质语言模型预测蛋白可溶性，并结合模拟退火优化进行可溶性重设计，属于蛋白质序列-性质预测与生成优化，虽非直接结构建模，但方法可迁移至蛋白结构相关计算。
documents.abstract: MOTIVATION: Protein solubility is a critical property that significantly impacts therapeutic efficacy and protein reengineering applications. Recent advances in machine learning and deep learning techniques provide unprecedented opportunities to develop predictive models for solubility, enabling more efficient protein design and optimization. This work is motivated by the potential of leveraging deep learning to address the solubility prediction challenge and to accelerate protein engineering workflows. RESULTS: Leveraging and combining multiple protein language model representations, our MiLaSol model attains 81% accuracy, outperforming prior methods, with the highest Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) score of 0.63 demonstrating balanced performance across both soluble and insoluble proteins. Through simulated annealing optimization coupled with the Raygun model, we also present a computational method to reengineer insoluble protein variants into soluble forms, with predictions confirmed by multiple independent solubility prediction methods. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining machine learning-based solubility prediction with generative optimization for protein engineering. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: MiLaSol is available at https://github.com/weiweiloutufts/milasolAn archived version of the code at the time of submission can be found at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21495202. 动机：蛋白质溶解度是一个关键性质，显著影响治疗效力和蛋白质重工程应用。机器学习和深度学习技术的最新进展为开发溶解度预测模型提供了前所未有的机会，从而实现更高效的蛋白质设计和优化。本工作的动机在于利用深度学习解决溶解度预测挑战并加速蛋白质工程工作流程的潜力。结果：通过利用和组合多种蛋白质语言模型表示，我们的MiLaSol模型达到了81%的准确率，优于先前方法，最高马修斯相关系数（MCC）得分为0.63，展示了在可溶性和不溶性蛋白质上的平衡性能。通过模拟退火优化结合Raygun模型，我们还提出了一种计算方法，将不溶性蛋白质变体重工程为可溶形式，预测结果由多种独立溶解度预测方法确认。我们的结果证明了将基于机器学习的溶解度预测与生成优化相结合用于蛋白质工程的有效性。可用性和实现：MiLaSol可在https://github.com/weiweiloutufts/milasol获取。提交时的代码存档版本可在https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21495202找到。

documents.title: Integrated bioinformatics analysis of chromosomal deletion regions in glioblastoma identifies key genes linked to GABA(A) receptor signaling.
meta: Caglar, Hasan Onur; Meral, Berkay; Caglar, Fulya
Journal of biomolecular structure & dynamics
documents.summary: 该文通过生物信息学分析胶质母细胞瘤缺失区基因，结合分子动力学模拟研究GABA(A)受体相关蛋白结构变化，虽涉及蛋白结构模拟但对象为疾病标志物，方法创新性一般。
documents.abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most common aggressive brain tumor in adults. The development of therapy resistance in GBM necessitates the identification of novel biomarkers to guide molecularly targeted treatment strategies. This study aims to identify potential tumor suppressor genes in GBM and to evaluate their potential as therapeutic targets. Genes localized on deletion regions in GBM tumors were selected using the BioMart database. Microarray datasets containing GBM tumor and normal brain tissue samples were analyzed with GEO2R. A protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed for dDEGs on deletion regions using the String database to identify hub genes. The expression and structural changes of hub genes were examined using GEPIA2 and cBioPortal, respectively. GROMACS software was used to perform molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. A total of 1704 dDEGs located within the deletion regions of GBM tumors were identified. Expression levels of 11 hub genes, including subunits of the entire GABA(A) receptor complex, were significantly downregulated in TCGA GBM samples. Additionally, mutations in CACNA1D, GABRA1, and GABRB2 were predicted to disrupt protein structure and function. Meprobamate was selected as the agonist for GABA(A) receptor-related hub genes. MD simulations indicated that meprobamate remained associated with the GABA(A) receptor but exhibited time-dependent repositioning during the later stages of the simulation. CACNA1D, GABRA1, and GABRB2 may have potential tumor-suppressive roles in GBM. In addition, GABA(A) receptors may represent potential molecular targets in GBM, warranting further experimental investigation. 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是成人中最常见的侵袭性脑肿瘤。GBM治疗耐药性的发展 necessitates 识别新型生物标志物以指导分子靶向治疗策略。本研究旨在鉴定GBM中潜在的肿瘤抑制基因，并评估其作为治疗靶点的潜力。利用BioMart数据库选择位于GBM肿瘤缺失区域的基因。使用GEO2R分析包含GBM肿瘤和正常脑组织样本的微阵列数据集。利用String数据库为缺失区域上的dDEGs构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，以识别枢纽基因。分别使用GEPIA2和cBioPortal检查枢纽基因的表达和结构变化。使用GROMACS软件进行分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟。共鉴定出1704个位于GBM肿瘤缺失区域内的dDEGs。在TCGA GBM样本中，包括整个GABA(A)受体复合物亚基在内的11个枢纽基因的表达水平显著下调。此外，CACNA1D、GABRA1和GABRB2的突变被预测会破坏蛋白质结构和功能。选择甲丙氨酯作为GABA(A)受体相关枢纽基因的激动剂。MD模拟表明，甲丙氨酯与GABA(A)受体保持关联，但在模拟后期表现出时间依赖性重定位。CACNA1D、GABRA1和GABRB2可能在GBM中具有潜在的肿瘤抑制作用。此外，GABA(A)受体可能代表GBM中的潜在分子靶点，值得进一步实验研究。

documents.title: Water Under Molecular Crowding: From Femtosecond H-Bond Networks Dynamics to Biological Function.
meta: You, Xiao
Sub-cellular biochemistry
documents.summary: 该综述聚焦拥挤环境下水氢键网络动力学及其对蛋白质折叠和功能的影响，结合MD模拟与光谱方法，虽以水为对象但涉及蛋白质结构相关计算，方法贡献较弱。
documents.abstract: Cells are densely packed with macromolecules, creating a crowded environment that fundamentally alters water's hydrogen bond (H-bond) networks. H-bond networks, typically dynamic and tetrahedral in bulk water, are disrupted by macromolecular surfaces, confinement, and competitive solute interactions. Subtle shifts in H-bond lifetimes, connectivity, and reorientation dynamics cascade into large-scale biological consequences-modulating protein folding, enzymatic function, and liquid-liquid phase separation. This chapter highlights how recent advances in time-resolved vibrational spectroscopy (e.g., 2D IR) and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations unravel crowding's effects on water structure and dynamics. Emphasis is placed on how these techniques elucidate interfacial water's heterogeneous and slowed dynamics in cytoplasm-like environments, at membrane surfaces, and within membraneless biomolecular condensates. We discuss how these dynamic perturbations reshape free energy landscapes and modulate biomolecular function. Finally, the chapter proposes integrative frameworks to connect ultrafast spectroscopic and simulation data with mesoscale biophysical models. Such multiscale approaches are essential to capture the full implications of hydration under crowding, offering a pathway to understand how life is organized at the molecular level in its physiologically crowded native state. 细胞中充满大分子，营造出一个拥挤的环境，从根本上改变了水的氢键（H-bond）网络。在体相水中通常动态且呈四面体结构的氢键网络，受到大分子表面、空间限制以及竞争性溶质相互作用的干扰。氢键寿命、连通性和重定向动力学的细微变化会级联放大为大规模的生物学后果——调节蛋白质折叠、酶功能和液-液相分离 (liquid-liquid phase separation)。本章重点介绍时间分辨振动光谱（如二维红外光谱 (2D IR)）和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟的最新进展如何揭示拥挤对水结构和动力学的影响。重点在于这些技术如何阐明细胞质样环境、膜表面以及无膜生物分子凝聚体中界面水的异质性和减缓动力学。我们讨论了这些动态扰动如何重塑自由能景观并调节生物分子功能。最后，本章提出了整合框架，将超快光谱和模拟数据与介观尺度生物物理模型联系起来。这种多尺度方法对于全面理解拥挤条件下水合作用的影响至关重要，为理解生命在其生理性拥挤的天然状态下如何在分子层面组织提供了途径。

documents.title: ESpma: A method for assessing biological/non-biological interfaces using point-clouds-based structural features and protein language models.
meta: Nozawa, Sarah; Tomii, Kentaro; Fukasawa, Yoshinori
Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
documents.summary: 该文利用蛋白语言模型嵌入的界面局部池化与点云结构特征，开发了区分生物/非生物蛋白界面的轻量级方法，属于蛋白质结构相关的计算建模任务，但方法创新性有限且性能未显著超越现有方法。
documents.abstract: Distinguishing biological protein-protein interfaces from non-biological contacts remains an important task in structural biology, particularly as protein complex structures continue to accumulate. Recent advances in protein language models (pLMs) have expanded their use across diverse protein prediction tasks, including sequence-based protein-protein interaction prediction. Such approaches often pool representations over entire sequences, whereas structure-based methods commonly rely on more complex graph- or geometry-based integration. We therefore asked how much interface-relevant information could be extracted by simply pooling pLM embeddings over structurally defined local regions. Here, we revisited biological-versus-crystal interface classification as a structurally well-defined testbed for this question. We developed a framework that compares full-sequence pooling, interface-localized pooling of pLM embeddings, and multimodal integration of sequence-derived embeddings with point-cloud representations of protein surfaces. On two benchmark datasets, interface-localized pooling achieved stronger performance than full-sequence or non-interacting surface pooling across three pLM backbones. Despite its simplicity, the resulting representation performed within the range of established methods that rely on explicit evolutionary analysis or geometric modeling. Incorporating explicit geometric surface information changed performance slightly, without reaching statistical significance. Because the model is linear, the interface-level score decomposes exactly into per-residue contributions, which varied within amino-acid types. Together, our results indicate that the principal gain arises from localizing pLM embeddings to physically interacting residues, enabling a lightweight and accessible implementation for biological-versus-crystal interface classification. Code and scripts are available on GitHub: https://github.com/fukasawa-group/espma. 区分生物性蛋白质-蛋白质界面与非生物性接触仍是结构生物学中的一项重要任务，尤其是在蛋白质复合物结构持续积累的背景下。蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）的最新进展已将其应用扩展到多种蛋白质预测任务，包括基于序列的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用预测。此类方法通常对整个序列的表征进行池化，而基于结构的方法则常依赖更复杂的图或几何集成。因此，我们探究了通过简单地对结构定义的局部区域上的pLM嵌入进行池化，能提取多少界面相关信息。在此，我们将生物性-晶体界面分类重新审视为一个结构上明确定义的测试平台，以回答这一问题。我们开发了一个框架，比较了全序列池化、界面局部池化pLM嵌入，以及序列衍生嵌入与蛋白质表面点云表征的多模态集成。在两个基准数据集上，界面局部池化在三种pLM骨干网络中均实现了比全序列或非相互作用表面池化更强的性能。尽管其简单性，所得表征的性能处于依赖显式进化分析或几何建模的既有方法范围内。引入显式几何表面信息仅轻微改变性能，未达到统计显著性。由于模型是线性的，界面级分数可精确分解为每个残基的贡献，这些贡献在氨基酸类型间有所变化。综合来看，我们的结果表明，主要增益源于将pLM嵌入定位到物理相互作用的残基上，从而为生物性-晶体界面分类提供了一种轻量且易于实现的方案。代码和脚本可在GitHub上获取：https://github.com/fukasawa-group/espma。

documents.title: Conserved Asp233-Asp246 hydrogen bond modulates active site dynamics in class A beta-lactamases.
meta: Lopez-Gallego, Cristina V; Timmer, Monika; Vreede, Jocelyne; Ubbink, Marcellus
Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
documents.summary: 该文通过突变和分子动力学模拟研究β-内酰胺酶第二壳层Asp233-Asp246氢键对活性位点构象动态的调控，属于蛋白质结构计算问题，但方法创新性一般。
documents.abstract: Rigid enzymes catalyze chemical reactions by stabilizing the transition state through a specific conformation. Catalytic residues are precisely positioned, and enzyme dynamics are kept to a minimum. It is thought that conserved residues around the active site (second-shell residues) play a crucial role in positioning catalytic residues. Asp233 and Asp246 are two highly conserved second-shell residues in class A beta-lactamases, rigid enzymes that inactivate beta-lactam antibiotics. The two aspartates share a short hydrogen bond, linking beta-strands 3 and 4. The role of this interaction in Mycobacterium tuberculosis beta-lactamase BlaC was studied by mutating the Asp residues to Ala. Disruption of the hydrogen bond subtly affects the activity and stability of the enzyme, suggesting the interaction helps to fine-tune the active site. The effects are larger for BlaC D246A than for D233A, indicating that effects cannot solely be attributed to the loss of the hydrogen bond. Molecular dynamics calculations indicate a shift in the conformational landscape due to the mutations, altering the conformational equilibria of the catalytic residues toward less active states. The results illustrate that second-shell residues act as a complex network that supports the efficient positioning of the catalytic residues. 刚性酶通过特定构象稳定过渡态来催化化学反应。催化残基被精确定位，酶动力学保持在最低限度。据认为，活性位点周围的保守残基（第二壳层残基）在定位催化残基中起着关键作用。Asp233和Asp246是A类β-内酰胺酶（刚性酶，可使β-内酰胺类抗生素失活）中两个高度保守的第二壳层残基。这两个天冬氨酸共享一个短氢键，连接β-折叠链3和4。通过将Asp残基突变为Ala，研究了该相互作用在结核分枝杆菌β-内酰胺酶BlaC中的作用。氢键的破坏轻微影响酶的活性和稳定性，表明该相互作用有助于微调活性位点。BlaC D246A突变的影响大于D233A，表明这些影响不能仅归因于氢键的丧失。分子动力学计算表明，突变导致构象景观发生偏移，使催化残基的构象平衡向活性较低的状态转变。结果说明，第二壳层残基作为一个复杂网络发挥作用，支持催化残基的高效定位。

documents.title: Efflux pump gene ABCA as targets for deep learning-based de novo inhibitors in invasive aspergillosis caused by Aspergillus fumigatus.
meta: Ahmed, Noor Maath; Ismail, Rand Salwan Numan; Suleiman, Ahmed AbdulJabbar
Computational biology and chemistry
documents.summary: 该研究利用深度学习（Protein Generator、ProteinMPNN、OmegaFold）和分子动力学模拟设计靶向烟曲霉AbcA外排泵ATP结合域的从头蛋白结合剂，属于蛋白质结构计算设计在抗真菌耐药中的应用，方法创新但对象为真菌转运蛋白，与经典蛋白结构计算课题部分相关。
documents.abstract: This study aims to design and evaluate novel therapeutic binders targeting the ATP-binding region of the AbcA efflux transporter protein in Aspergillus fumigatus. By inhibiting ATP binding, these binders seek to prevent AbcA-mediated azole resistance and restore the effectiveness of antifungal treatments. The research employed a variety of computational modeling and deep learning techniques, such as multiple sequence alignment (MSA) to identify conserved regions, particularly the ATP-binding site. A de novo sequence and structure of the protein was predicted using Protein Generator based on the consensus conserved region, and 60 de novo protein sequences were designed with ProteinMPNN. To enhance intracellular delivery, cell-penetrating peptide (CPP) motifs were added, and their potential was assessed using C2Pred. Allergenicity was evaluated using AllerCatPro, and thermal stability was predicted with DeepSTABp to shortlisted top ten highly thermally stable de novo binders among 7200 generated binders. The de novo sequences were modelled using OmegaFold and subjected to energy minimization. Molecular docking was performed to analyze interactions between the abcA protein and the designed inhibitors, and binding energies were assessed using the GRAMM algorithm and PDBSum. Molecular dynamics simulations using Maestro indicated that the abcA-2795 complex exhibited the most stable conformation. The binding sites of the de novo binders were found to encompass the ATP-binding and transmembrane domains of the AbcA protein. In conclusion, the study successfully designed and evaluated de novo binders targeting the ATP-binding domain of AbcA in Aspergillus fumigatus. The binder abcA-2795 exhibited promising characteristics, including non-allergenicity, cell penetration potential, and high thermal stability, suggesting its potential as an effective inhibitor of fungal drug resistance. Further experimental validation is required to confirm the efficacy and safety of these binders in clinical settings. 本研究旨在设计并评估靶向烟曲霉（Aspergillus fumigatus）中AbcA外排转运蛋白ATP结合区的新型治疗性结合剂。通过抑制ATP结合，这些结合剂旨在阻止AbcA介导的唑类耐药性，并恢复抗真菌治疗的有效性。研究采用了多种计算建模和深度学习技术，例如多序列比对（MSA）以识别保守区域，特别是ATP结合位点。基于共识保守区域，使用Protein Generator预测了蛋白质的从头序列和结构，并利用ProteinMPNN设计了60个从头蛋白质序列。为增强细胞内递送，添加了细胞穿透肽（CPP）基序，并使用C2Pred评估其潜力。使用AllerCatPro评估致敏性，并通过DeepSTABp预测热稳定性，以从7200个生成的结合剂中筛选出前十名高稳定性从头结合剂。从头序列使用OmegaFold建模并进行能量最小化。进行分子对接以分析abcA蛋白与设计抑制剂之间的相互作用，并使用GRAMM算法和PDBSum评估结合能。使用Maestro进行的分子动力学模拟表明，abcA-2795复合物表现出最稳定的构象。从头结合剂的结合位点被发现涵盖AbcA蛋白的ATP结合域和跨膜域。总之，本研究成功设计并评估了靶向烟曲霉中AbcA ATP结合域的从头结合剂。结合剂abcA-2795表现出有前景的特性，包括非致敏性、细胞穿透潜力和高热稳定性，表明其作为真菌耐药性有效抑制剂的潜力。需要进一步的实验验证以确认这些结合剂在临床环境中的有效性和安全性。

documents.title: Effects of plant polyphenols on water-holding capacity and quality of frozen bighead carp (Hypophthalmichthys nobilis) fillets: insights from molecular docking.
meta: Liu, Chenxi; Wang, Yiming; Yu, Qinye; Mubango, Elliot; Luo, Yongkang; Tan, Yuqing; Hong, Hui
Food chemistry
documents.summary: 该文研究植物多酚对冷冻鳙鱼片保水性和品质的影响，虽含分子对接分析，但核心是食品冷冻保存实验，蛋白质仅作为食品基质，非蛋白质结构计算研究。
documents.abstract: This study evaluated dihydromyricetin (DMY), tannic acid (Tan), and resveratrol (Res) as natural cryoprotectants for bighead carp (Hypophthalmichthys nobilis) fillets during frozen storage (-20  degrees C, 8 weeks). Fillets treated with 0.1% (w/w) polyphenols were compared with a water control and a commercial sucrose-sorbitol cryoprotectant. Changes in water migration, water-holding capacity, protein and lipid oxidation, protein conformation, odor profiles, and sensory quality were systematically investigated, together with molecular docking analysis. Frozen storage induced progressive conversion of immobilized water to free water, accompanied by increased moisture loss and oxidative deterioration, whereas polyphenol treatments significantly mitigated these effects. Res restricted free-water formation and preserved water-holding capacity the most effectively, while Tan exhibited the strongest inhibition of lipid oxidation. Both Res and Tan better maintained myofibrillar protein secondary and tertiary structures and sensory quality during prolonged storage, whereas DMY mainly exerted protective effects at the early storage stage. Molecular docking analysis demonstrated favorable binding of all three polyphenols to beta-actin, with docking scores of -8.0 kcal/mol for Tan, -6.5 kcal/mol for DMY, and - 5.5 kcal/mol for Res, indicating distinct protein interaction modes. Overall, 0.1% resveratrol and tannic acid best preserved water-holding capacity and inhibited oxidation in frozen bighead carp fillets, with molecular docking revealing stable polyphenol-beta-actin interactions. These polyphenols show promise as targeted cryoprotectants for frozen fish. 本研究评估了二氢杨梅素（dihydromyricetin, DMY）、单宁酸（tannic acid, Tan）和白藜芦醇（resveratrol, Res）作为天然冷冻保护剂，在冷冻贮藏（-20°C，8周）期间对鳙鱼（Hypophthalmichthys nobilis）鱼片的作用。将经0.1%（w/w）多酚处理的鱼片与清水对照组及商业蔗糖-山梨醇冷冻保护剂组进行比较。系统研究了水分迁移、持水性、蛋白质和脂质氧化、蛋白质构象、气味特征及感官品质的变化，并结合分子对接分析。冷冻贮藏诱导固定水逐渐转化为自由水，伴随水分损失增加和氧化劣变加剧，而多酚处理显著缓解了这些影响。Res最有效地限制了自由水的形成并保持了持水性，而Tan对脂质氧化的抑制最强。在长期贮藏期间，Res和Tan均更好地维持了肌原纤维蛋白的二级和三级结构及感官品质，而DMY主要在贮藏早期发挥保护作用。分子对接分析显示，三种多酚均能与β-肌动蛋白良好结合，对接分数分别为Tan -8.0 kcal/mol、DMY -6.5 kcal/mol和Res -5.5 kcal/mol，表明存在不同的蛋白质相互作用模式。总体而言，0.1%白藜芦醇和单宁酸最能保持冷冻鳙鱼鱼片的持水性并抑制氧化，分子对接揭示了稳定的多酚-β-肌动蛋白相互作用。这些多酚有望作为冷冻鱼类的靶向冷冻保护剂。

documents.title: Toward autonomous science with agentic artificial intelligence.
meta: Guo, Lucie Y; Ting, Darren S J; Su, Xinyi; Aliper, Alex; Zhavoronkov, Alex; Ting, Daniel S W
Cell
documents.summary: 该文综述了生物医学中智能体AI的演进，提及AlphaFold等蛋白质结构预测工具，但核心是科学推理与自主实验室，而非蛋白质结构计算建模本身，仅部分相关。
documents.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) in biomedicine has evolved from pattern-recognition for medical image analysis to generative models like AlphaFold that predict protein structures. Tools such as Elicit, GPT-Rosalind, and Claude Science now bridge prediction and reasoning through literature synthesis, domain-tuned models, and agentic workbenches. Three recent systems (Co-Scientist, Robin, and Biomni) demonstrated agentic AI capable of generating hypotheses, designing experiments, computational analysis, and refining reasoning through experimental feedback. This perspective traces the emergence of agentic scientific reasoning, discusses scaling laws and autonomous laboratories, and argues that AI's transformative potential is inseparable from challenges in hallucination, bias, irreproducibility, and dual use. Scientific progress will depend on responsible human-AI collaboration. 生物医学中的人工智能（AI）已从医学图像分析的模式识别，演进至如AlphaFold等预测蛋白质结构的生成模型。诸如Elicit、GPT-Rosalind和Claude Science等工具，现通过文献综合、领域定制模型及智能体工作台，将预测与推理相连接。近期三个系统（Co-Scientist、Robin和Biomni）展示了能够生成假设、设计实验、进行计算分析，并通过实验反馈优化推理的智能体AI。本视角追溯了智能体科学推理的出现，探讨了扩展定律与自主实验室，并主张AI的变革潜力与幻觉、偏见、不可复现性及双重使用等挑战密不可分。科学进步将依赖于负责任的人机协作。

documents.title: Dark proteome and emerging technologies for functional characterization and drug discovery.
meta: Haque, Md Azizul; Kim, Jong-Joo; Danishuddin
Drug discovery today
documents.summary: 综述暗蛋白质组及其功能表征和药物发现技术，涉及AI结构预测等计算方法，但以综述为主且非聚焦具体蛋白质结构计算建模。
documents.abstract: Despite major advances in genomics and proteomics, a substantial portion of the human proteome remains poorly characterized and is commonly known as the 'dark proteome'. These understudied proteins often lack detailed structural, functional, and biochemical information, limiting our understanding of their biological roles and therapeutic potential. Recent developments in artificial intelligence (AI)-based structure prediction, cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM), functional genomics, and multi-omics technologies have provided new opportunities to explore this hidden region of the proteome. Characterizing the dark proteome could reveal novel therapeutic targets for cancer, neurodegenerative, metabolic, and rare genetic diseases. In this review, we summarize current knowledge of the dark proteome, highlight emerging experimental and computational approaches, discuss key challenges, and outline prospects for translating dark proteome discoveries into therapeutic applications. 尽管基因组学和蛋白质组学取得了重大进展，人类蛋白质组中仍有相当一部分未被充分表征，通常被称为“暗蛋白质组 (dark proteome)”。这些研究不足的蛋白质往往缺乏详细的结构、功能和生化信息，限制了我们对其生物学角色和治疗潜力的理解。基于人工智能 (AI) 的结构预测、冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM)、功能基因组学和多组学技术的最新发展，为探索蛋白质组的这一隐藏区域提供了新机遇。表征暗蛋白质组可能揭示癌症、神经退行性疾病、代谢性疾病和罕见遗传病的新治疗靶点。在本综述中，我们总结了暗蛋白质组的当前知识，重点介绍了新兴的实验和计算方法，讨论了关键挑战，并概述了将暗蛋白质组发现转化为治疗应用的前景。

documents.title: Pose2Muscle: Structured Spatio-Temporal Decoding for Discrete Muscle Activity Estimation from Human Pose
meta: Yuepeng Chen; Jiehong Shi; Kaili Zheng; Boyi Zhang; Chenyi Guo; Ji Wu; Xiangling Fu
arXiv
documents.summary: 该文从人体姿态估计离散肌肉活动状态，虽涉及结构化预测和时空注意力，但核心对象是人体运动与肌肉信号，而非蛋白质结构计算，与课题无关。
documents.abstract: Muscle activity is fundamental to human movement, and understanding its patterns is critical for injury prevention and rehabilitation. Conventional muscle activity monitoring relies on specialized sensors such as surface electromyography, which limits its practicality for long-term real-world use. Existing studies suggest that muscle-related information can be inferred from human pose. However, the substantial gap between externally observable pose and internal muscle activation, limits the accuracy and generalization of current approaches. In this study, we propose Pose2Muscle, a pose-driven framework for discrete muscle activity estimation without requiring sEMG signals at inference time. Instead of directly regressing continuous sEMG signals, Pose2Muscle reformulates muscle estimation as a structured prediction problem over discrete muscle activity states, yielding a more stable and interpretable target space. The framework combines multi-scale spatio-temporal attention to capture motion patterns at complementary spatial and temporal scales with a directed acyclic graph-based decoder that maintains multiple candidate muscle-state hypotheses and performs structured trajectory inference over time. To support this task, we construct PoseEMG-43, a synchronized pose-sEMG dataset containing 2,992 movement instances from 43 daily-life actions performed by 14 participants. Experiments show that Pose2Muscle consistently outperforms representative retrieval- and pose-based baselines. It achieves an Adjacent-level Accuracy of 86.36% and a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.8821 under the Random Split, and 63.97% and 0.6795, respectively, under the Subject-Level Split. These results demonstrate the feasibility of inferring structured muscle-state patterns from human pose and suggest the potential of Pose2Muscle for muscle-aware movement analysis when direct physiological sensing is impractical 肌肉活动是人类运动的基础，理解其模式对于损伤预防和康复至关重要。传统的肌肉活动监测依赖于表面肌电图等专用传感器，这限制了其在长期现实世界应用中的实用性。现有研究表明，肌肉相关信息可以从人体姿态中推断出来。然而，外部可观察姿态与内部肌肉激活之间的显著差距，限制了当前方法的准确性和泛化能力。在本研究中，我们提出Pose2Muscle，一种无需推理时sEMG信号的姿态驱动框架，用于离散肌肉活动估计。Pose2Muscle不直接回归连续sEMG信号，而是将肌肉估计重新表述为离散肌肉活动状态上的结构化预测问题，从而产生更稳定且可解释的目标空间。该框架结合多尺度时空注意力以捕捉互补空间和时间尺度上的运动模式，并采用基于有向无环图的解码器，该解码器维护多个候选肌肉状态假设并随时间执行结构化轨迹推理。为支持此任务，我们构建了PoseEMG-43，一个同步的姿态-sEMG数据集，包含来自14名参与者执行的43种日常动作的2,992个运动实例。实验表明，Pose2Muscle始终优于代表性的检索式和基于姿态的基线方法。在随机划分下，它实现了86.36%的相邻级别准确率和0.8821的皮尔逊相关系数，在受试者级别划分下分别达到63.97%和0.6795。这些结果证明了从人体姿态推断结构化肌肉状态模式的可行性，并表明在直接生理传感不可行时，Pose2Muscle在肌肉感知运动分析中的潜在应用价值。

documents.title: Provable Guarantees for Spectral Structured Prediction
meta: Violet Zheng; Jean Honorio
arXiv
documents.summary: 该文研究带边翻转噪声的符号图上的谱结构化预测理论，与蛋白质结构计算无关。
documents.abstract: Structured prediction is the simultaneous prediction of multiple labels, and is widely used in various fields, such as natural language processing and computer vision. In this paper, we study binary node label recovery on signed graphs with edge-flip noise, a model introduced by (Globerson et al., 2015), via a simple spectral method that decodes node labels from the signs of the principal eigenvector of the noisy signed adjacency matrix. We develop graph structure-agnostic theoretical guarantees for approximate inference of node labels as well as guarantees for maximum angle deviation with respect to the ground truth node labels. By leveraging tools from matrix concentration theory and eigenvector perturbation analysis, we derive new concentration inequalities that explicitly quantify the effect of the spectral gap of the adjacency matrix, number of nodes, degree distribution, and noise level. As a corollary, we relate our general results to the Cheeger constant and provide results for different classes of graphs. We perform several synthetic experiments to validate our theory. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to provide theoretical guarantees for the spectral-based approach. As a byproduct of our analysis, we derive technical results that might be of independent interest and useful for other machine learning problems. 结构化预测是同时预测多个标签的任务，在自然语言处理和计算机视觉等多个领域广泛应用。本文研究带边翻转噪声的符号图上的二值节点标签恢复问题，该模型由(Globerson et al., 2015)提出，我们采用一种简单的谱方法，通过从带噪声符号邻接矩阵的主特征向量的符号中解码节点标签。我们为节点标签的近似推断开发了与图结构无关的理论保证，并提供了关于与真实节点标签最大角度偏差的保证。通过利用矩阵集中理论和特征向量扰动分析的工具，我们推导出新的集中不等式，明确量化了邻接矩阵谱间隙、节点数量、度分布和噪声水平的影响。作为推论，我们将一般结果与Cheeger常数联系起来，并为不同类别的图提供结果。我们进行了多项合成实验以验证我们的理论。据我们所知，我们是首个为基于谱的方法提供理论保证的研究。作为分析的副产品，我们推导出可能具有独立兴趣并对其他机器学习问题有用的技术结果。

documents.title: Machine-Learned Dynamical Representations for Accelerated RiteWeight Convergence
meta: Sagar Kania
arXiv
documents.summary: 该文比较了DeepTICA和SPIB-VAE等机器学习表示在加速RiteWeight轨迹重加权收敛中的效果，核心是蛋白质构象系综的动力学重加权计算，属于蛋白质结构相关的AI方法研究。
documents.abstract: The increasing use of generative models has made ensembles of short molecular dynamics trajectories increasingly common, creating a growing need for methods that can recover physically meaningful steady-state populations and kinetics from improperly weighted conformational ensembles. Randomized Iterative Trajectory Reweighting (RiteWeight) addresses this problem through repeated random clustering and iterative reweighting, without requiring the fixed Markovian discretization used in conventional Markov state models (MSM). However, the choice of reduced feature space in which RiteWeight performs random clustering has not been systematically investigated. Here, we compare two machine-learned representations, DeepTICA and SPIB-VAE, with linear TICA for recovering steady-state observables from flawed distributions. DeepTICA learns nonlinear coordinates by targeting slow transfer-operator eigenmodes, whereas SPIB-VAE compresses configurations into a low-dimensional latent space while retaining information predictive of future metastable states. DeepTICA provided a comparatively robust RiteWeight representation under limited hyperparameter exploration, whereas SPIB-VAE benefited more strongly from broader optimization. Moreover, a kinetic score computed from a coarse MSM at a resolution comparable to that used for RiteWeight random clustering provided a useful criterion for efficiently selecting reduced representations and their hyperparameters for RiteWeight. 生成模型日益广泛的应用使得短分子动力学轨迹集合愈发常见，这催生了对能够从不正确加权的构象系综中恢复具有物理意义的稳态群体和动力学的方法的需求。随机迭代轨迹重加权（RiteWeight）通过重复随机聚类和迭代重加权来解决这一问题，无需传统马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）中使用的固定马尔可夫离散化。然而，RiteWeight 执行随机聚类时所采用的约化特征空间的选择尚未得到系统研究。在此，我们比较了两种机器学习表示方法，即 DeepTICA 和 SPIB-VAE，与线性 TICA 在从有缺陷分布中恢复稳态可观测量方面的表现。DeepTICA 通过靶向慢传递算子本征模式来学习非线性坐标，而 SPIB-VAE 则将构象压缩到低维潜在空间，同时保留预测未来亚稳态状态的信息。在有限的超参数探索下，DeepTICA 为 RiteWeight 提供了相对稳健的表示，而 SPIB-VAE 则更受益于更广泛的优化。此外，从与 RiteWeight 随机聚类分辨率相当的粗粒度 MSM 计算得到的动力学评分，为高效选择 RiteWeight 的约化表示及其超参数提供了有用标准。

documents.title: Calibrated structural homology transfer yields putative molecular functions for domains of unknown function in four model proteomes
meta: Pannu JS; Green K; Vedanayagam J
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文利用AlphaFold结构预测和Foldseek远程同源搜索，对未知功能结构域进行功能注释并系统评估可靠性，属于蛋白质结构预测的应用与基准测试，方法创新有限但问题和方法与课题相关。
documents.abstract: Improvements in computational protein structure prediction have enabled searches for remote homologs of proteins whose molecular function remain unknown. However, the reliability of functional annotations from such searches has not been systematically quantified. In this study, we assembled a time-split benchmark from Pfam families annotated as domains of unknown function (DUFs) in Pfam 28.0 and were subsequently assigned a function in the current release (Pfam 38.0). These retrospective-DUFs provide ground truth for assessing functional annotation from remote homology searches. In our benchmark analysis, we paired retrospective-DUFs with a difficulty-matched arm from known domains to distinguish query difficulty from the method’s performance. Across four model proteomes (yeast, C. elegans , Drosophila , and mice), Foldseek searches against AlphaFold/Swiss-Prot, PDB100, and CATH50 recovered the later-assigned function for 15.9% of retrospective DUF queries, compared with 30.1% of matched known-domain queries, after masking for self-family and self-clan level hits to remove circularity. At a fixed confidence cut-off (qTM ≥ 0.5), 55.4% of informative calls on retrospective DUFs were incorrect, establishing an error model for prospective use. Furthermore, in our comparison of tools for homology searches, Foldseek outperformed MMseq2-based sequence search but was not statistically separable from the ESM-2 protein language model embedding baseline. Applying the calibrated structural homology search pipeline to 296 currently unannotated DUF queries in Pfam 38.0 yielded 50 confident, specific functional assignments. We provide the benchmark and ranked candidates as a resource to facilitate functional studies. 计算蛋白质结构预测的改进使得能够搜索分子功能未知的蛋白质的远缘同源物。然而，此类搜索功能注释的可靠性尚未被系统量化。在本研究中，我们从Pfam 28.0中注释为未知功能域（DUFs）的Pfam家族构建了一个时间分割基准，这些家族在当前版本（Pfam 38.0）中随后被赋予了功能。这些回顾性DUFs为评估远缘同源搜索的功能注释提供了真实依据。在我们的基准分析中，我们将回顾性DUFs与难度匹配的已知域配对，以区分查询难度与方法性能。在四个模型蛋白质组（酵母、线虫、果蝇和小鼠）中，针对AlphaFold/Swiss-Prot、PDB100和CATH50的Foldseek搜索，在屏蔽自家族和自氏族级别命中以消除循环性后，恢复了15.9%的回顾性DUF查询的后续分配功能，而匹配的已知域查询为30.1%。在固定置信度截断值（qTM ≥ 0.5）下，回顾性DUFs上55.4%的信息性调用是错误的，为前瞻性使用建立了错误模型。此外，在我们对同源搜索工具的比较中，Foldseek优于基于MMseq2的序列搜索，但在统计上与ESM-2蛋白质语言模型嵌入基线无显著差异。将校准的结构同源搜索流程应用于Pfam 38.0中296个当前未注释的DUF查询，产生了50个自信且特异的功能分配。我们提供基准和排名候选作为资源，以促进功能研究。

documents.title: Deciphering the evolutionary origin of the enantioselectivity of short-chain dehydrogenases from plants toward 1-borneol.
meta: Zuson, Jasmin; Helmer, Carl P O; Di Geronimo, Bruno; Chanique, Andrea M; Kavciakova, Katarina; Teijeiro-Juiz, Rosa; Brickel, Sebastian; Ramirez Molina, Nuria; Drienovska, Ivana; Kracher, Daniel; Gaucher, Eric A; Kamerlin, Shina Caroline Lynn; Loll, Bernhard; Kourist, Robert
Nature communications
documents.summary: 该文通过祖先序列重建、晶体结构和机器学习/分子力学及漏斗元动力学模拟，研究植物短链脱氢酶对1-龙脑的对映选择性的进化起源，属于蛋白质结构相关的计算模拟研究，但对象为酶催化选择性而非典型结构预测/生成问题。
documents.abstract: Enzyme engineering has produced numerous methods to optimize enzymes for biotechnological processes; however, less is known about how natural evolution creates new functionalities. We investigate the evolutionary emergence of enantioselectivity in plant borneol dehydrogenases, which feature hydrophobic active-sites and are enantioselective towards dibornane-type monoterpenols. Ancestral sequence reconstruction provided a trajectory from the oldest unselective ancestor N30 (E = 12) toward a more recent selective ancestor N32, involving 19 mutations: 18 mutations are peripheral, one (I111L) occurs in the active-site. The mutation L111I in the hydrophobic pocket increased the selectivity of N30, while the back-mutation I111L decreased the selectivity of N32. Additional peripheral mutations (V136L/G169A/V183I) were required for high selectivity. Crystal structures suggested that protein dynamics rather than structural changes shape these catalytic properties; this was confirmed by Machine Learning/Molecular Mechanics simulations of ligand binding. Funnel-metadynamics simulations revealed a correlation between the active-site's solvent-accessible surface area and selectivity. This potential evolutionary pathway shapes enantioselectivity, and guides future enzyme engineering campaigns. 酶工程已开发出众多方法来优化用于生物技术过程的酶；然而，关于自然进化如何创造新功能，我们知之甚少。我们研究了植物龙脑脱氢酶中对映选择性的进化出现，这些酶具有疏水性活性位点，并对二冰片烷型单萜醇具有对映选择性。祖先序列重建提供了从最古老的无选择性祖先N30（E = 12）到较新的选择性祖先N32的轨迹，涉及19个突变：其中18个突变位于外围，一个（I111L）发生在活性位点。疏水口袋中的L111I突变增加了N30的选择性，而反向突变I111L降低了N32的选择性。额外的外围突变（V136L/G169A/V183I）是实现高选择性所必需的。晶体结构表明，蛋白质动力学而非结构变化塑造了这些催化特性；这一点通过配体结合的机器学习/分子力学模拟得到证实。漏斗元动力学模拟揭示了活性位点溶剂可及表面积与选择性之间的相关性。这一潜在的进化途径塑造了对映选择性，并为未来的酶工程活动提供指导。

documents.title: Cathode lithium-rich compensators for next-generation lithium-ion batteries.
meta: Liu, Fangzheng; Wang, Lin; Zhao, Shu; Liu, Meixin; Yu, Qi; Yang, Xiaojing; Li, Yang; Guo, Xianwei; Bai, Zhenhui; Wang, Guoqing; Zhang, Xu; Sun, Yingzhi; Hu, Yaqi; Liu, Na; Yu, Haijun
Chemical Society reviews
documents.summary: 该文综述锂离子电池正极富锂补偿剂，聚焦电池材料与电化学性能，不涉及蛋白质结构计算，与课题无关。
documents.abstract: Active lithium loss during initial cycling and long-term operation is a key factor limiting the energy density and cycling life of lithium-ion batteries (LIBs). Among various prelithiation approaches developed to address this challenge, cathode lithium-rich compensators (LRCs) have garnered widespread attention due to their superior lithium compensation efficiency and excellent compatibility with conventional electrode fabrication processes. Despite rapid progress in this field, the relationships among lithium-release chemistry, charge-compensation mechanisms, electrode compatibility, and cell-level performance remain insufficiently organized. In this review, we first establish a classification framework for cathode LRCs based on their lithium compensation mechanisms, covering binary, ternary, over-lithiated, sacrificial lithium salts, and sustained-release types, and systematically summarize their working principles, typical charge compensation pathways, and practical performance. Subsequently, we discuss key challenges, including air instability, gas evolution, high delithiation voltage, and processing issues. Finally, we highlight the corresponding mitigation strategies involving nanoscale engineering, surface coating, defect and doping design, and electrolyte optimization. Through comparative investigation of lithium compensation approaches on the cathode-side and anode-side, and electrolyte-mediated lithium compensation strategies, we clarify their complementary effects. Building on these insights, we propose a synergistic multimodal lithium-compensation strategy that integrates one-shot prelithiation with sustained lithium release. Furthermore, an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven strategy for the synergistic optimization of cathode-, anode-, and electrolyte-side prelithiation is proposed. The potential of AI for materials screening, molecular structure design, and the precise matching of lithium sources was also systematically analyzed. This review aims to provide a coherent picture of cathode prelithiation chemistry and to offer practical guidance for material design, electrode engineering, and system integration toward high-energy-density, long-life LIBs. 锂离子电池（LIBs）在初始循环和长期运行过程中的活性锂损失是限制其能量密度和循环寿命的关键因素。在为解决这一挑战而开发的各种预锂化方法中，正极富锂补偿剂（LRCs）因其优异的补锂效率和与传统电极制造工艺的良好兼容性而受到广泛关注。尽管该领域进展迅速，但锂释放化学、电荷补偿机制、电极兼容性以及电池级性能之间的关系仍未得到充分梳理。在本综述中，我们首先基于锂补偿机制建立了正极LRCs的分类框架，涵盖二元、三元、过锂化、牺牲性锂盐和缓释型等类型，并系统总结了它们的工作原理、典型电荷补偿途径和实际性能。随后，我们讨论了关键挑战，包括空气不稳定性、气体析出、高脱锂电压和加工问题。最后，我们重点介绍了相应的缓解策略，涉及纳米尺度工程、表面包覆、缺陷与掺杂设计以及电解液优化。通过对正极侧和负极侧锂补偿方法以及电解液介导的锂补偿策略的比较研究，我们阐明了它们的互补效应。基于这些见解，我们提出了一种协同多模式锂补偿策略，将一次性预锂化与持续锂释放相结合。此外，还提出了一种人工智能（AI）驱动的策略，用于正极、负极和电解液侧预锂化的协同优化。同时系统分析了AI在材料筛选、分子结构设计以及锂源精确匹配方面的潜力。本综述旨在为正极预锂化化学提供一幅连贯的图景，并为面向高能量密度、长寿命LIBs的材料设计、电极工程和系统集成提供实用指导。

documents.title: In silico analysis of MALAT1 and H19 lncRNA interactions with the diabetes-related proteins ASK1 and YAP1.
meta: Cabrera-Najera, Leonardo Elias; Rodriguez-Pena, Olga Nelly; Flores-Ortiz, Cesar Mateo; Palomar-Morales, Martin
In silico pharmacology
documents.summary: 该文用结构预测、分子对接和MD模拟分析lncRNA与糖尿病相关蛋白ASK1/YAP1的相互作用界面，虽对象为RNA-蛋白复合物，但计算框架可迁移至蛋白质结构计算研究。
documents.abstract: Dysregulation of RNA-protein signalling networks contributes to the progression of diabetes-associated complications, yet the structural mechanisms underlying lncRNA interactions with key signalling proteins remain largely unknown.
