Thus, rigid docking alone tended to generate a substantial number of false-positive poses. However, MD simulations applied after docking effectively identified unstable ligand poses and reduced false-positive predictions by detecting ligand dissociation. Overall true-positive rates were 30% for SWISS-MODEL and 35% for AlphaFold2. These findings highlight the importance of dynamic validation in structure-based drug discovery workflows. 准确的蛋白质结构预测是基于结构的药物发现的基础。然而，与传统的同源建模方法（如SWISS-MODEL）相比，基于深度学习的模型（如AlphaFold）在实际药物设计工作流程中的性能尚未得到充分评估。在此，我们使用一个包含20个与共结晶配体结合的激酶结构的精选数据集，系统性地对AlphaFold2和SWISS-MODEL进行了基准测试。预测模型在三种条件下进行评估：原始预测结构、经过能量最小化的结构，以及经过三次100纳秒无偏分子动力学（MD）模拟进行结构细化的结构。模型性能通过结构准确性指标、多软件对接（AutoDock Vina、AutoDock和MOE）以及对接后MD轨迹稳定性分析，结合MM/GBSA结合能估算来评估。如预期，实验结构始终表现出最佳的对接性能。在预测模型中，SWISS-MODEL产生的RMSD值略低，且相互作用相似性优于AlphaFold，尽管总体对接分数在统计上相当。对接前的MD细化通过增加结合口袋偏差降低了结构适用性，并与后续对接计算中配体取向错误相关，而能量最小化几乎没有提供改进。值得注意的是，对接性能的下降不仅限于计算预测结构，也出现在与不同配体共结晶的实验结构中。因此，仅刚性对接往往会产生大量假阳性姿态。然而，对接后应用的MD模拟通过检测配体解离，有效识别了不稳定的配体姿态并减少了假阳性预测。总体真阳性率分别为SWISS-MODEL的30%和AlphaFold2的35%。这些发现强调了动态验证在基于结构的药物发现工作流程中的重要性。

documents.title: Structural basis of active state coupling of metabotropic glutamate receptor 8 to beta-arrestins.
meta: Marx, Dagan C; Huynh, Kevin; Gonzalez-Hernandez, Alberto J; Strauss, Alexa; Rico, Carlos; Gallo, Pamela N; Sharghi Moshtaghin, Sheida; Arefin, Anisul; Broichhagen, Johannes; Eliezer, David; Khelashvili, George; Levitz, Joshua
Nature communications
documents.summary: 该文通过冷冻电镜、负染EM和分子动力学模拟解析mGluR8与β-arrestin复合物的活性态结构及偶联机制，属于蛋白质结构计算研究，但核心贡献偏向实验结构解析，MD模拟为辅助验证。
documents.abstract: Metabotropic glutamate receptors (mGluRs) are prototypical, dimeric family C G protein-coupled receptors (GPCR) that perform crucial modulatory roles throughout the nervous system. While mGluR activation and signaling through G proteins has been studied extensively, how these receptors interact with and are desensitized by beta-arrestins (beta-arrs) is not well understood. Here, we use an integrative biophysical and structural approach to probe the coupling of mGluR8 and beta-arrs. Using negative stain electron microscopy (EM), we identify tail- and core-bound orientations and stoichiometries of mGluR8/beta-arr complexes. Cryo-EM structures of mGluR8 alone or bound to either G proteins or beta-arr1 reveal mGluR8 active states with transducer-specific differences. The mGluR8/beta-arr structure shows a distinct complex orientation compared to other GPCR/beta-arr structures which supports a steric mechanism of mGluR desensitization involving interactions with both subunits and the lipid bilayer. Coupling of mGluR8 to beta-arr1 in an active-like conformation is verified by live-cell and single molecule FRET analysis. Finally, molecular dynamics simulations further define the positioning and dynamics of mGluR8-bound beta-arr1 and the importance of critical mGluR8 residues for stabilizing beta-arr1 complexes. Together, our data provide a framework for agonist-driven family C GPCR/beta-arr coupling. 代谢型谷氨酸受体（mGluRs）是典型的二聚体C家族G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR），在整个神经系统中发挥关键的调节作用。尽管mGluR的激活及通过G蛋白的信号传导已被广泛研究，但这些受体如何与β-arrestins（beta-arrs）相互作用并被其脱敏的机制尚不明确。在此，我们采用整合的生物物理和结构方法，探讨mGluR8与β-arrestins的偶联。通过负染色电子显微镜（EM），我们识别了mGluR8/β-arr复合物的尾部结合和核心结合取向及化学计量比。单独mGluR8或与G蛋白或β-arr1结合的冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）结构揭示了mGluR8活性状态，并显示出转导子特异性差异。mGluR8/β-arr结构展示了与其他GPCR/β-arr结构不同的复合物取向，支持一种涉及两个亚基及脂质双层的mGluR脱敏空间位阻机制。mGluR8与β-arr1在活性样构象中的偶联通过活细胞和单分子FRET分析得到验证。最后，分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟进一步定义了mGluR8结合的β-arr1的定位和动态，以及关键mGluR8残基在稳定β-arr1复合物中的重要性。综合来看，我们的数据为激动剂驱动的C家族GPCR/β-arr偶联提供了框架。

documents.title: A Novel SXXLF Motif in the FXR N-Terminal Domain Mediates Coregulator and Interdomain Interactions.
meta: Villalona, Priscilla; Pulahinge, Thilini; Yu, Tracy; Wenning, Jordan; Khan, Sabab Hasan; Frisbie, Crawford Joseph; Magafas, Jill; Barbe, Addison; Okafor, C Denise
Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
documents.summary: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和实验方法，鉴定FXR核受体N端结构域中一个新型SXXLF基序介导共调节因子和结构域间相互作用，涉及蛋白质构象与变构耦合，但核心对象是核受体而非通用蛋白质结构计算，方法上仅使用MD模拟，缺乏AI/深度学习等前沿计算手段。
documents.abstract: The nuclear receptor (NR) superfamily is comprised of ligand-regulated transcription factors that contain an intrinsically disordered domain at the amino-terminal end, known as the N-terminal domain (NTD). While this poorly conserved domain is known to possess ligand-independent activation function (AF-1), few NTD functions are conserved between NRs. Identified roles in other receptors include androgen receptor (AR), estrogen receptor (ER), and mineralocorticoid receptor (MR). Here, we aim to define the function of the NTD of the farnesoid X receptor (FXR), a crucial regulator of lipid and bile acid metabolism. We show that the NTD engages in interdomain contact with other FXR domains. We also observe that the NTD interacts directly with coregulator proteins. Using mutagenesis, mammalian two-hybrid assays, mammalian one-hybrid assay, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, we identify and validate a novel SXXLF motif in the NTD which mediates interactions with both coregulators and the ligand binding domain. Mutation of the motif induces large changes in conformational and allosteric coupling in FXR. Our study identifies a new nuclear receptor-interacting motif that modulates the transcriptional activity of FXR. 核受体（nuclear receptor, NR）超家族由配体调控的转录因子组成，其氨基末端含有一个内在无序结构域，称为N端结构域（N-terminal domain, NTD）。尽管已知这一保守性较差的结构域具有不依赖配体的激活功能（AF-1），但NTD的少数功能在NRs之间是保守的。在其他受体中已鉴定的作用包括雄激素受体（androgen receptor, AR）、雌激素受体（estrogen receptor, ER）和盐皮质激素受体（mineralocorticoid receptor, MR）。在此，我们旨在定义法尼醇X受体（farnesoid X receptor, FXR）NTD的功能，FXR是脂质和胆汁酸代谢的关键调节因子。我们表明，NTD与其他FXR结构域发生结构域间接触。我们还观察到，NTD直接与辅调节蛋白相互作用。通过诱变、哺乳动物双杂交实验、哺乳动物单杂交实验和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，我们鉴定并验证了NTD中一个新的SXXLF基序，该基序介导与辅调节因子和配体结合结构域的相互作用。该基序的突变诱导FXR构象和变构偶联发生重大变化。我们的研究识别出一个新的核受体相互作用基序，该基序调节FXR的转录活性。

documents.title: Multi-state Structure Prediction of G Protein-Coupled Receptor Proteins via Prompting on AlphaFold.
meta: Sun, Zhigang; Zhang, Tao; Zhang, Kexin; Pang, Anqi; Yu, Jiale; Zeng, Liting; Yang, Sibei; Zhao, Suwen; Zheng, Jie
Computational and structural biotechnology journal
documents.summary: 该文提出PromptGPCR，通过向AlphaFold模型注入结构生物学知识提示，实现GPCR活性/非活性多状态结构预测，并验证其在分子对接中的实用性，属于蛋白质结构预测与AI方法的直接结合。
documents.abstract: G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), an essential family of transmembrane proteins, widely participate in signal transduction in organisms and have long been recognized as a major class of therapeutic targets. In structure-based drug design, high-resolution structures of GPCRs in both active and inactive states are essential for designing agonists and antagonists, respectively. However, obtaining experimental GPCR structures is costly, while homology modeling and artificial-intelligence-driven approaches including AlphaFold 2 and AlphaFold 3 often show reduced accuracy for active-state conformations. To address the above limitations, we propose PromptGPCR, an AlphaFold-based inference framework aiming to predict highly accurate structures of GPCRs in both active and inactive states. We provide AlphaFold-Multimer and AlphaFold 3 with biological sequences based on knowledge of structural biology as prompts to guide the models in the multi-state prediction task. Experimental results demonstrate that PromptGPCR can accurately predict active and inactive structures compared to baselines, suggesting its ability to provide structural hypotheses where state-resolved experimental structures are unavailable. Furthermore, PromptGPCR exhibits higher success rates in molecular docking than baselines, and this indicates that the predictions of PromptGPCR may have a certain degree of usability in downstream application scenarios involving specific GPCR conformational states. G蛋白偶联受体（G protein-coupled receptors, GPCRs）是一类重要的跨膜蛋白家族，广泛参与生物体内的信号转导，并长期被视为主要的治疗靶点类别。在基于结构的药物设计中，GPCRs在活性和非活性状态下的高分辨率结构分别对于设计激动剂和拮抗剂至关重要。然而，获取实验性GPCR结构成本高昂，而同源建模及包括AlphaFold 2和AlphaFold 3在内的人工智能驱动方法在预测活性状态构象时往往准确性降低。为解决上述局限性，我们提出PromptGPCR，一种基于AlphaFold的推理框架，旨在预测GPCRs在活性和非活性状态下的高精度结构。我们向AlphaFold-Multimer和AlphaFold 3提供基于结构生物学知识的生物序列作为提示，以引导模型在多状态预测任务中的表现。实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，PromptGPCR能够准确预测活性和非活性结构，表明其在缺乏状态分辨实验结构的情况下能提供结构假设的能力。此外，PromptGPCR在分子对接中表现出比基线更高的成功率，这提示PromptGPCR的预测在涉及特定GPCR构象状态的下游应用场景中可能具有一定程度的实用性。

documents.title: AI-assisted design and virtual profiling of targeted degraders for pancreatic cancer therapy via PROTAC technology.
meta: Du, Bing; Wang, Kunjie; Wu, Zhu; Qiu, Shaofan; Konstantinos, Filippiadis Dimitrios; Yu, Shuo
American journal of cancer research
documents.summary: 该文利用AI辅助和结构引导的计算流程设计靶向BRD4的PROTAC降解剂，涉及蛋白结构评估、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，属于蛋白质结构相关的计算建模，但对象为小分子-蛋白复合物且方法偏工程化应用，创新性一般。
documents.abstract: Pancreatic cancer remains one of the most lethal malignancies because of late diagnosis, aggressive progression, therapy resistance, and limited effective treatment options. Bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4) is an important epigenetic regulator implicated in pancreatic cancer progression through its role in transcriptional control, cell proliferation, and survival signaling. Targeted protein degradation using proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) offers a potential strategy for eliminating disease-associated proteins through ubiquitin-proteasome-mediated degradation rather than transient pharmacological inhibition. In this study, an AI-assisted and structure-guided computational workflow was used to design and virtually prioritize BRD4-targeting PROTAC candidates recruiting DCAF15 as the E3 ligase component. The workflow integrated protein-structure evaluation, pharmacophore-based ligand screening, ADMET and Lipinski filtering, binary protein-ligand docking, molecular-interaction analysis, rational linker selection, BRD4-DCAF15 protein-protein docking, PROTAC-mediated ternary-complex docking, and molecular dynamics simulation. The results identified CLTTMPBA-linker-E7820 as a computationally prioritized PROTAC architecture with favorable predicted binding behavior, residue-level interaction patterns, and simulated ternary-complex stability. Importantly, this study is entirely computational and should be interpreted as an early-stage in silico prioritization framework rather than experimental evidence of BRD4 degradation or anticancer efficacy. The proposed BRD4-DCAF15 PROTAC candidates represent lead hypotheses that require biochemical, cellular, pharmacological, and in vivo validation, including confirmation of target engagement, ternary-complex formation, proteasome-dependent BRD4 degradation, downstream transcriptional modulation, pancreatic cancer cell inhibition, selectivity, pharmacokinetics, toxicity, and antitumor efficacy. 胰腺癌仍是最致命的恶性肿瘤之一，原因在于诊断延迟、进展侵袭性强、治疗耐药以及有效治疗选择有限。含溴结构域蛋白4 (BRD4) 是一种重要的表观遗传调控因子，通过其在转录控制、细胞增殖和存活信号中的作用参与胰腺癌进展。利用蛋白水解靶向嵌合体 (PROTACs) 的靶向蛋白降解提供了一种潜在策略，通过泛素-蛋白酶体介导的降解而非瞬时药理学抑制来消除疾病相关蛋白。在本研究中，采用了一种AI辅助和结构引导的计算工作流程，用于设计并虚拟优先筛选以DCAF15为E3连接酶组分的BRD4靶向PROTAC候选分子。该工作流程整合了蛋白质结构评估、基于药效团的配体筛选、ADMET和Lipinski过滤、二元蛋白-配体对接、分子相互作用分析、合理连接子选择、BRD4-DCAF15蛋白-蛋白对接、PROTAC介导的三元复合物对接以及分子动力学模拟。结果鉴定出CLTTMPBA-linker-E7820作为计算优先的PROTAC架构，具有有利的预测结合行为、残基级相互作用模式以及模拟的三元复合物稳定性。重要的是，本研究完全基于计算，应被解读为早期阶段的计算机优先排序框架，而非BRD4降解或抗癌功效的实验证据。所提出的BRD4-DCAF15 PROTAC候选分子代表先导假设，需要生化、细胞、药理学和体内验证，包括确认靶点结合、三元复合物形成、蛋白酶体依赖性BRD4降解、下游转录调控、胰腺癌细胞抑制、选择性、药代动力学、毒性和抗肿瘤功效。

documents.title: Humanizing Antibodies and Nanobodies From Scratch With HuDiff.
meta: Nan, Yang; Sun, Hongshuai; Zhang, Bo; Yang, Yue; He, Jianxin; Bai, Qifeng
Bio-protocol
documents.summary: 提出HuDiff，一种基于自回归扩散模型的从头抗体/纳米抗体人源化方法，仅需CDR序列即可生成人源化抗体，属于蛋白质序列设计问题，方法创新且直接服务于蛋白质结构相关计算。
documents.abstract: Antibody (Ab) and nanobody (Nb) humanization is essential for reducing immunogenicity in therapeutic applications. HuDiff is an adaptive autoregressive diffusion approach that generates humanized antibodies and nanobodies from scratch using only complementarity-determining region sequences as input, eliminating the need for preexisting human templates. The method follows a two-stage training pipeline: pretraining on human antibody sequences to learn framework region patterns, followed by fine-tuning on target-species sequences. HuDiff-Ab processes paired heavy and light chains for conventional antibodies, while HuDiff-Nb can incorporate a specialized inpainting mode to preserve critical nanobody framework residues. This protocol provides a complete step-by-step guide for implementing HuDiff, covering data preparation, model training, and sequence generation. Key features * Requires only CDR sequences as input and does not require human template selection. * Uses a two-stage training strategy, with pretraining on human antibody sequences and fine-tuning on target-species sequences guided by humanness scores. * HuDiff-Ab humanizes paired heavy and light chains simultaneously, whereas HuDiff-Nb provides an inpainting mode to preserve key framework residues. * Generates multiple diverse humanized candidates for downstream experimental screening. 抗体（Ab）和纳米抗体（Nb）的人源化对于减少治疗应用中的免疫原性至关重要。HuDiff是一种自适应自回归扩散方法，仅使用互补决定区序列作为输入，从头生成人源化抗体和纳米抗体，无需预先存在的人类模板。该方法采用两阶段训练流程：先在人类抗体序列上进行预训练以学习框架区模式，随后在目标物种序列上进行微调。HuDiff-Ab处理常规抗体的配对重链和轻链，而HuDiff-Nb可整合专门的修补（inpainting）模式，以保留关键的纳米抗体框架残基。本协议提供了实施HuDiff的完整分步指南，涵盖数据准备、模型训练和序列生成。关键特征 * 仅需CDR序列作为输入，无需人类模板选择。 * 采用两阶段训练策略，在人类抗体序列上预训练，并在目标物种序列上以人源化评分指导微调。 * HuDiff-Ab同时人源化配对的重链和轻链，而HuDiff-Nb提供修补模式以保留关键框架残基。 * 生成多个多样化的人源化候选序列，供下游实验筛选使用。

documents.title: Explainable AI reveals the allosteric blind spot in protein-ligand binding predictions.
meta: Parikh, Vedant; Foley, Brandon; Gatlin, Will; Ludwick, Max; Turano, Lucas; Verkhivker, Gennady M
Cell reports. Physical science
documents.summary: 该文开发可解释AI框架系统评估多种蛋白-配体结合预测模型在别构与正构位点上的性能差异，并结合能量景观理论揭示别构预测盲区的物理机制，核心聚焦蛋白质结构计算建模问题，方法上融合AI与物理模拟，具有方法创新性。
documents.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed prediction of protein structure and interactions, yet modeling of allosteric binding remains a persistent challenge. We develop an explainable AI framework that interrogates AI models AlphaFold3, Protenix, Boltz-2, Chai-1, and DynamicBind on rigorously stratified datasets of orthosteric and allosteric ligand-protein complexes. While AI models excel in accurate modeling of orthosteric ligand binding, a consistent and substantial performance gap observed across diverse architectures emerges in prediction of allosteric complexes. The biophysical logic for this dichotomy is unveiled through physics-based lens of the energy landscape theory. Orthosteric binding creates dominant energetic funnels via ligand-induced minimal frustration quenching, while allosteric sites preserve neutral frustration landscapes in both apo and holo protein states. By linking prediction outcomes to frustration landscapes, this study recasts AI shortcomings in prediction of allosteric ligand binding as diagnostic indicators of allostery, establishing a physics-informed framework that turns the allosteric blind spot into mechanistic insight. 人工智能（AI）已变革了蛋白质结构与相互作用的预测，但变构结合（allosteric binding）的建模仍是一个持续挑战。我们开发了一个可解释的AI框架，在严格分层的正构（orthosteric）与变构（allosteric）配体-蛋白质复合物数据集上，对AI模型AlphaFold3、Protenix、Boltz-2、Chai-1和DynamicBind进行探究。尽管AI模型在正构配体结合的精确建模中表现出色，但在变构复合物的预测中，不同架构间一致且显著的性能差距显现出来。通过能量景观理论（energy landscape theory）的物理学视角，揭示了这一二分法的生物物理逻辑。正构结合通过配体诱导的最小挫败淬灭（ligand-induced minimal frustration quenching）产生主导性能量漏斗，而变构位点在无配体（apo）与结合配体（holo）蛋白质状态下均保持中性挫败景观（neutral frustration landscape）。通过将预测结果与挫败景观（frustration landscape）相关联，本研究将AI在变构配体结合预测中的不足重新定义为变构性的诊断指标，建立了一个将变构盲点转化为机制性见解的物理学知情框架。

documents.title: Investigation of salt-bridge interactions underlying salt activation of halophilic methionine sulfoxide reductase A.
meta: Chen, Shuhong; Liu, Lianghui; Zhou, Hailang; Kuang, Xiaoxue; Li, Ye; Liu, Rong; Yang, Jiawei; Cheng, Xiaoling
Frontiers in microbiology
documents.summary: 该文通过分子动力学模拟、突变分析和活性实验，研究嗜盐蛋白HhMsrA中盐桥相互作用对其盐依赖性激活和结构维持的机制，属于蛋白质结构计算与实验结合的研究。
documents.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Halophilic microorganisms inhabit hypersaline environments where sustained ionic stress challenges protein structure and function, making salt-responsive enzymes important for cellular fitness. Here, we investigated the salt-bridge interactions that support salt-dependent activation of a halophilic methionine sulfoxide reductase A from Halobacterium hubeiense (HhMsrA), a key enzyme involved in repairing oxidized methionine residues. METHODS: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, mutagenesis analyses, enzyme activity assays, and circular dichroism (CD) measurements were used to identify key salt-bridge-forming residues and evaluate their contributions to the salt-dependent structural and functional behavior of HhMsrA. RESULTS: MD simulations and mutagenesis analyses identified Arg106 and Lys76 as prominent salt-bridge nodes, and charge-conservative substitutions at these positions largely preserved the high-salt activity profile, whereas non-conservative substitutions (e.g., acidic, hydrophobic, aromatic, or proline replacements) generally reduced activity. Moreover, combined proline substitutions produced a pronounced cumulative effect, leaving the enzyme with only minimal activity even under high-salt conditions. MD analyses further associated these site-specific salt-bridge interactions with the maintenance of the salt-adapted structural state required for HhMsrA activity. CD measurements further showed a strong KCl-dependent helical response in HhMsrA that was attenuated to varying degrees across mutants targeting salt-bridge-forming residues. DISCUSSION: These findings demonstrate that salt-dependent activity of HhMsrA is supported by a small set of salt-bridge nodes that contribute to maintaining a high-salt structural state compatible with HhMsrA catalytic function. 引言：嗜盐微生物栖息于高盐环境中，持续的离子胁迫对蛋白质结构和功能构成挑战，使得盐响应酶对细胞适应性至关重要。在此，我们研究了支持来自湖北盐杆菌（Halobacterium hubeiense）的嗜盐甲硫氨酸亚砜还原酶A（HhMsrA）盐依赖性激活的盐桥相互作用，该酶是修复氧化甲硫氨酸残基的关键酶。方法：采用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟、突变分析、酶活性测定和圆二色 (circular dichroism) 测量，以识别关键盐桥形成残基，并评估它们对HhMsrA盐依赖性结构和功能行为的贡献。结果：分子动力学模拟和突变分析确定Arg106和Lys76为显著盐桥节点，这些位置上的电荷保守替换在很大程度上保留了高盐活性谱，而非保守替换（例如酸性、疏水性、芳香族或脯氨酸替换）通常降低活性。此外，组合脯氨酸替换产生显著累积效应，使酶在高盐条件下也仅保留最低活性。分子动力学分析进一步将这些位点特异性盐桥相互作用与维持HhMsrA活性所需的盐适应结构状态相关联。圆二色测量进一步显示，HhMsrA中强烈的KCl依赖性螺旋响应在针对盐桥形成残基的突变体中不同程度减弱。讨论：这些发现表明，HhMsrA的盐依赖性活性由一小部分盐桥节点支持，这些节点有助于维持与HhMsrA催化功能兼容的高盐结构状态。

documents.title: Structure and spectroscopy of propane and propene in the solid state from neutron powder diffraction and inelastic neutron scattering.
meta: Fortes, A Dominic; Howard, Christopher M; Parker, Stewart F
IUCrJ
documents.summary: 该文利用中子衍射和力场结构预测方法研究丙烷和丙烯的固态结构与光谱，对象为小分子而非蛋白质，不涉及蛋白质结构计算问题，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: Using high-resolution neutron powder diffraction data, we have refined the previously determined monoclinic structure of the stable beta-phase of perdeuterated propane at 10 K and characterized the anisotropic thermal expansion from 10 to 80 K. Using the same methods, we have determined the structure of the stable orthorhombic beta-phase of perdeuterated propene for the first time and similarly characterized its thermal expansion between 10 and 85 K. Combining these results with published thermodynamic data, we estimate the magnitude of the volume isotope effect (VIE) in propane and propene to provide parameterizations of the density of each substance in the natural protiated form from limiting low temperature up to their respective melting points. We have been able to establish, using force-field-based structure prediction methods, that the metastable alpha-phase of propene forms a body-centred tetragonal crystal with a nearly identical packing arrangement to the stable beta-phase. This represents an original use of structure prediction methods to obtain results retrospectively from a 28-year-old powder diffraction study with data of low quality, rather than the more usual application of pro-active materials discovery, suggesting promising computational - and perhaps AI or machine learning driven - routes to extracting value from archived historical data. Inelastic neutron scattering spectroscopy, combined with density functional theory calculations, have yielded vibrational mode assignments for beta-propane, and for both alpha- and beta-propene, in protiated and deuterated isotopologues. This work provides astronomers with the data required to interpret accurately the infrared spectra of interstellar ice grains and cloud condensates in gas giant planet atmospheres, and provides planetary scientists with information on the temperature-dependent densities necessary to model accurately the behaviour of hydrocarbon sediment grains in various extraterrestrial fluid environments, such as Titan's ethane rivers and seas. 利用高分辨率中子粉末衍射数据，我们精修了全氘代丙烷在10 K下稳定β相先前确定的单斜结构，并表征了其在10至80 K范围内的各向异性热膨胀。采用相同方法，我们首次确定了全氘代丙烯稳定β相的正交结构，并类似地表征了其在10至85 K之间的热膨胀。将这些结果与已发表的热力学数据相结合，我们估算了丙烷和丙烯中体积同位素效应 (VIE) 的大小，从而提供了每种物质在天然质子化形式下从极限低温至各自熔点的密度参数化。利用基于力场的结构预测方法，我们得以确定丙烯的亚稳态α相形成体心四方晶体，其堆积排列与稳定β相几乎相同。这是结构预测方法的一种创新应用，用于从28年前的低质量粉末衍射研究中回顾性地获取结果，而非更常见的主动材料发现应用，这表明了从存档历史数据中提取价值的计算驱动——或许还有人工智能或机器学习驱动——的可行途径。非弹性中子散射光谱学结合密度泛函理论计算，得出了β-丙烷以及α-和β-丙烯在质子化和氘化同位素体中的振动模式归属。这项工作为天文学家提供了准确解释星际冰粒和气态巨行星大气中云凝聚物红外光谱所需的数据，并为行星科学家提供了温度依赖性密度的信息，这些信息对于准确模拟各种地外流体环境（如土卫六的乙烷河流和海洋）中烃类沉积颗粒的行为是必要的。

documents.title: Deciphering the Role of the Nonactive Site Ancillary Residues in Maintaining the Activity and Substrate Specificity of the OXA-232 beta-Lactamase.
meta: Tejavath, Ajith; Biju, Bayomi; Panda, Aditya Prasad; Jain, Diamond; Chowdhury, Chiranjit; Ghosh, Anindya Sundar
ACS infectious diseases
documents.summary: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和实验结合，研究非活性位点残基对OXA-232 β-内酰胺酶活性和底物特异性的维持作用，涉及蛋白质结构-功能关系，但核心是酶学机制而非结构计算建模方法创新。
documents.abstract: OXA-232, an OXA-48 - like carbapenemase stands among newly identified beta-lactamases that causes of the extensive of beta-lactam resistance. While active-site residues are well characterized, the contributions of conserved nonactive-site residues in exerting enzymatic activity remain unexplored, limiting our understanding about the roles of these residues in the overall OXA-232 function. To address these gaps, the conserved residues S118, V120, L158, and D159 of OXA-232 positioned adjacent to the active-site motifs and within the Omega-loop were substituted with alanine. Substitutions of S118A and D159A rendered the expressing cells susceptible to penicillins, cephalosporins, and carbapenems, whereas the cells harboring OXA-232V120A and OXA-232L158A exhibited substrate-selective susceptibility changes. Kinetic analysis with purified proteins revealed the reduction in catalytic efficiency of all the mutants compared to wild-type protein. Though the L158A and D159A mutated proteins become deacylation-deficient, the mutations S118A and V120A exhibited selective acylation defects without trapping intermediates. It is evident from circular dichroism spectroscopy and molecular dynamics simulations that OXA-232S118A, OXA-232V120A, OXA-232L158A and OXA-232D159A nearly retained their secondary structures and compactness. Interestingly, bicarbonate supplementation partially rescued the lost activities in soluble mutants, underscoring the carbamylation dependence. Taken together, these findings establish S118 and D159 as essential for core catalysis and structural integrity, with V120 and L158 modulating substrate-specific turnover and orientation. The current study reappraised the mechanistic insights of OXA-48-like carbapenemases, providing significant resources in rationally designing future therapeutics to combat carbapenem resistance. OXA-232，一种OXA-48样碳青霉烯酶，属于新发现的β-内酰胺酶之一，导致β-内酰胺耐药性的广泛扩展。尽管活性位点残基已被充分表征，但保守的非活性位点残基在发挥酶活性中的贡献仍未探索，限制了我们对这些残基在OXA-232整体功能中作用的理解。为弥补这些空白，将OXA-232中位于活性位点基序附近及Omega-loop内的保守残基S118、V120、L158和D159替换为丙氨酸。S118A和D159A的替换使表达细胞对青霉素类、头孢菌素类和碳青霉烯类变得敏感，而携带OXA-232V120A和OXA-232L158A的细胞则表现出底物选择性敏感性变化。纯化蛋白的动力学分析显示，与野生型蛋白相比，所有突变体的催化效率均降低。尽管L158A和D159A突变蛋白变得去酰化缺陷，但S118A和V120A突变表现出选择性酰化缺陷，未捕获中间体。圆二色光谱和分子动力学模拟表明，OXA-232S118A、OXA-232V120A、OXA-232L158A和OXA-232D159A几乎保留了其二级结构和紧凑性。有趣的是，碳酸氢盐补充部分恢复了可溶性突变体中丧失的活性，强调了氨甲酰化依赖性。综合来看，这些发现确立了S118和D159对核心催化和结构完整性至关重要，而V120和L158则调节底物特异性转换和取向。本研究重新评估了OXA-48样碳青霉烯酶的机制见解，为合理设计未来治疗策略以对抗碳青霉烯耐药性提供了重要资源。

documents.title: Uncovering hub genes and key pathways responsive to drought stress in rice via meta-analysis of transcriptomic data.
meta: Joshi, Sachin; Chaudhary, Parneeta; Mrinal, Rishi; Chauhan, Ankita; Pandey, Niharika; Gautam, Sneh; Lohani, Pushpa
Computational biology and chemistry
documents.summary: 该文通过转录组元分析挖掘水稻干旱响应关键基因和通路，不涉及蛋白质结构计算、AI或物理模拟方法，与课题无关。
documents.abstract: Drought stress presents a formidable threat to global rice cultivation, triggering complex molecular responses that impact plant growth and productivity. To decipher the underlying gene expression dynamics, we performed a comprehensive meta-analysis of transcriptomic datasets derived from drought-tolerant rice genotypes. Via microarray data from three independent studies, we identified a set of consistently expressed differentially expressed genes (DEGs) under drought conditions. Integration of functional annotation tools, including GO and KEGG pathway enrichment, revealed key biological processes and signaling cascades involved in stress mitigation, such as ABA signaling, protein folding, and photosynthesis suppression. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) network construction, followed by hub gene identification via maximal clique centrality (MCC), highlighted pivotal regulators including LEA proteins, dehydrins, HSP70, and several transcription factors. Machine learning approaches further prioritize potential biomarkers, with Random Forest models achieving high classification accuracy and pinpointing key predictive genes. Chromosomal localization analysis provided spatial insights into the distribution of these hub genes, whose expression patterns were further compared against qRT-PCR data from previously published studies. This integrative approach identifies candidate genomic markers and mechanistic insights that may support future breeding strategies for drought-tolerant rice, pending experimental validation. 干旱胁迫对全球水稻种植构成严峻威胁，触发复杂的分子响应，影响植物生长与生产力。为解析潜在的基因表达动态，我们对源自耐旱水稻基因型的转录组数据集进行了全面的荟萃分析。通过来自三项独立研究的微阵列数据，我们鉴定了一组在干旱条件下持续表达的差异表达基因（DEGs）。整合功能注释工具（包括GO和KEGG通路富集分析），揭示了参与胁迫缓解的关键生物学过程和信号级联反应，如ABA信号传导、蛋白质折叠和光合作用抑制。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络构建，随后通过最大团中心性（MCC）进行枢纽基因鉴定，突出了关键调控因子，包括LEA蛋白、脱水素、HSP70及若干转录因子。机器学习方法进一步优先筛选潜在生物标志物，其中随机森林模型实现了高分类精度，并精准定位了关键预测基因。染色体定位分析提供了这些枢纽基因分布的空间信息，其表达模式进一步与已发表研究中的qRT-PCR数据进行了比较。这种整合方法识别了候选基因组标记和机制性见解，可能为未来耐旱水稻育种策略提供支持，但尚需实验验证。

documents.title: Computational investigation of ternary Mg-Co-B compounds as cathode materials for Mg-ion batteries.
meta: Paitandi, Somnath; Upadhyay, Shivansh; Bhattacharyya, Kalishankar
Physical chemistry chemical physics : PCCP
documents.summary: 该文研究Mg-Co-B三元硼化物作为镁离子电池正极材料，虽涉及结构预测和机器学习势，但研究对象为非蛋白质的无机材料，与蛋白质结构计算课题无关。
documents.abstract: The sluggish development of Mg-ion batteries is largely attributed to the scarcity of cathode materials that concurrently offer high specific capacity, suitable intercalation voltages, and low Mg-ion migration barriers. In this work, a structure prediction workflow combining an evolutionary algorithm with convex hull analysis was employed to generate and screen Mg-Co-B ternary boride materials, from which three thermodynamically stable compounds MgCoB, MgCo(3)B(2), and Mg(3)Co(3)B(2) were identified. The dynamical, thermodynamic, and ground-state stability of all three compounds was thoroughly confirmed through phonon dispersion calculations, Gibbs free energy analysis, and convex hull formation energies, respectively. To efficiently screen the large number of possible symmetry inequivalent Mg-extraction configurations, a machine learning interatomic potential was employed for structural exploration, followed by DFT calculations for accurate energetic evaluation, thereby substantially reducing the computational cost. Subsequent DFT-based electrochemical analysis reveals that Mg(3)Co(3)B(2) is electrochemically unsuitable due to anomalously large negative intercalation voltages, while MgCo(3)B(2) is limited by a prohibitively high Mg-ion migration barrier of 0.75 eV. In contrast, MgCoB emerges as the most promising material, exhibiting a theoretical specific capacity of 356.2 mAh g(-1), a gravimetric energy density of 278 Wh kg(-1), and a substantially reduced Mg-ion migration barrier of 0.35 eV, depicting it as a highly competitive cathode material for next-generation Mg-ion batteries. 镁离子电池发展缓慢，主要归因于缺乏同时具备高比容量、合适嵌入电压和低镁离子迁移势垒的正极材料。在本工作中，采用结合进化算法与凸包分析的结构预测流程，生成并筛选了Mg-Co-B三元硼化物材料，从中识别出三种热力学稳定化合物：MgCoB、MgCo(3)B(2)和Mg(3)Co(3)B(2)。通过声子色散计算、吉布斯自由能分析和凸包形成能，分别全面确认了这三种化合物的动力学、热力学和基态稳定性。为高效筛选大量可能的对称不等价镁脱出构型，采用机器学习原子间势进行结构探索，随后通过DFT计算进行精确能量评估，从而大幅降低计算成本。后续基于DFT的电化学分析揭示，Mg(3)Co(3)B(2)因异常大的负嵌入电压而不适合电化学应用，而MgCo(3)B(2)则受限于高达0.75 eV的镁离子迁移势垒。相比之下，MgCoB成为最具前景的材料，其理论比容量为356.2 mAh g(-1)，重量能量密度为278 Wh kg(-1)，且镁离子迁移势垒显著降低至0.35 eV，表明其是下一代镁离子电池中极具竞争力的正极材料。

documents.title: Gromov-Wasserstein Barycenter Surrogates: Statistical Methodology, Distributional Limits and Applications
meta: Florian Steinkamp; Luis-Alberto Rodríguez; Jan Victor Otte; Axel Munk
arXiv
documents.summary: 该文提出基于Gromov-Wasserstein距离的统计方法用于匹配度量度量空间，并应用于蛋白质结构域比较，但核心是统计理论而非蛋白质结构计算建模，且未涉及AI或物理模拟方法。
documents.abstract: We introduce statistical theory for the matching of finitely many objects, represented as metric measure spaces (mm-spaces). The approach is based on the second lower bound (SLB) of the Gromov-Wasserstein distance and thus is able to identify deviations in the distributions of the (pairwise) distances within each mm-space. We introduce a surrogate of the SLB barycenter which can be easily computed and expressed explicitly in terms of the distance distributions of each object. When comparing $m$ mm-spaces for $n$ randomly drawn samples in each space, the resulting statistic then can be calculated efficiently in $O(m \cdot n^2 \log(n))$ basic operations. We derive the asymptotic distribution and finite-sample bounds of the proposed test statistic, which serves as a basis for a variety of tools for statistical inference, specifically an asymptotic test for pose-invariant object discrimination and a classification method (based on the SLB barycenter) with controlled error rates. These methods are investigated in simulations and applied to the structural comparison of protein domains. 我们引入了用于有限多个对象匹配的统计理论，这些对象表示为度量测度空间 (metric measure spaces, mm-spaces)。该方法基于Gromov-Wasserstein距离的第二下界 (second lower bound, SLB)，因此能够识别每个mm-space内（成对）距离分布中的偏差。我们引入了一个SLB重心 (SLB barycenter) 的替代量，该替代量易于计算，并可显式地表示为每个对象距离分布的函数。当比较$m$个mm-space，且每个空间中有$n$个随机抽取的样本时，所得统计量可通过$O(m \cdot n^2 \log(n))$次基本操作高效计算。我们推导了所提出检验统计量的渐近分布和有限样本界，这为多种统计推断工具提供了基础，具体包括用于姿态不变对象区分的渐近检验，以及一种具有可控错误率的分类方法（基于SLB重心）。这些方法在模拟中进行了研究，并应用于蛋白质结构域的结构比较。

documents.title: Sequence and structural determinants of efficacious de novo chimaeric antigen receptors.
meta: Chow, Arthur; Chu, Hoyin; Li, Ruofan; Nalbant, Benan N; Dozic, Abdul Vehab; Kida, Laura C; Tang, Zeyu; Palmeri, Joseph R; Lareau, Caleb A
Nature biomedical engineering
documents.summary: 该文利用AI生成蛋白设计流程筛选新型嵌合抗原受体（CAR）的序列和结构决定因素，虽以蛋白质结构为核心对象，但主要聚焦于CAR-T细胞治疗的功能验证和工程优化，而非蛋白质结构计算建模的方法创新，对蛋白质结构计算课题的启发有限。
documents.abstract: Advances in generative protein design using artificial intelligence (AI) have enabled the rapid development of binders against heterogeneous targets, including tumour-associated antigens. Despite extensive biochemical characterization, these novel protein binders have had limited evaluation in candidate therapeutics, including chimaeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells. Here we synthesize generative protein design workflows to screen 1,758 newly designed protein binders targeting BCMA, CD19 and CD22 for efficacy in scalable protein-binding, T-cell activation and in vivo killing assays. We characterize three main challenges that hinder the utility of de novo protein binders as CARs, including tonic signalling, occluded epitope engagement and off-target activity. We develop computational and experimental heuristics to overcome these limitations, including screens of sequence variants of individual parental structures, that retain on-target CAR activation while mitigating liabilities. Together, our framework accelerates the development of AI-designed proteins for future preclinical therapeutic screening, helping enable a new generation of cellular therapies. 利用人工智能（AI）的生成式蛋白质设计进展，已能够针对异质性靶标（包括肿瘤相关抗原）快速开发结合蛋白。尽管经过广泛的生化表征，这些新型蛋白质结合蛋白在候选治疗药物（包括嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T细胞）中的评估仍十分有限。在此，我们整合生成式蛋白质设计工作流程，筛选了1,758种新设计的靶向BCMA、CD19和CD22的蛋白质结合蛋白，并在可扩展的蛋白质结合、T细胞激活及体内杀伤实验中评估其效力。我们表征了阻碍从头设计蛋白质结合蛋白作为CAR应用的三个主要挑战，包括强直信号、表位结合受阻及脱靶活性。我们开发了计算与实验启发式方法以克服这些限制，包括对单个亲本结构的序列变体进行筛选，这些变体在保留靶向CAR激活的同时减轻了相关缺陷。综上，我们的框架加速了AI设计蛋白质的未来临床前治疗筛选，助力新一代细胞疗法的实现。

documents.title: Breaking timescales with generative sampling of conformational transitions.
meta: Tang, Chenyu; Pandey, Mayank Prakash; Chen, Cheng Giuseppe; Megias, Alberto; Dehez, Francois; Chipot, Christophe
Nature
documents.summary: 该文提出生成式通量引导路径采样框架Gen-COMPAS，结合扩散模型与committor过滤，无需预定义反应坐标即可高效重构蛋白质构象转变路径，属于蛋白质构象采样与生成的核心方法创新。
documents.abstract: Molecular transitions, including protein folding, allostery and membrane transport, are central to biological functions, yet remain notoriously difficult to simulate. Their intrinsic rarity places them beyond the reach of standard molecular dynamics, whereas enhanced-sampling strategies are computationally demanding and often depend on arbitrarily chosen parameters and variables that bias outcomes(1-3). Here we introduce Gen-COMPAS, a generative committor-guided path-sampling framework that reconstructs transition pathways without predefined collective variables and at acceptable computational cost. Gen-COMPAS couples a denoising diffusion probabilistic model, which produces structurally plausible intermediate targets, with committor-based filtering to identify transition states(4,5). Short unbiased simulations from these intermediates yield transition-region ensembles at nanosecond-to-submicrosecond aggregate sampling scales for which conventional approaches require orders of magnitude more sampling. Applied to systems ranging from a miniprotein to a pentameric, ligand-gated ion channel, Gen-COMPAS recovers committors, transition states and free-energy landscapes from known end-point structures alone, without predefined reaction coordinates or prior mechanistic knowledge, thereby providing a computationally tractable route to mechanistic insight in biomolecular systems that have so far resisted conventional simulation approaches. 分子转变，包括蛋白质折叠、变构和膜转运，是生物功能的核心，然而其模拟仍以困难著称。这些转变的内在稀有性使其超出标准分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 的能力范围，而增强采样策略计算成本高昂，且通常依赖于任意选择的参数和变量，从而对结果产生偏差(1-3)。在此，我们介绍Gen-COMPAS，一种生成性通量器引导的路径采样框架，能够在无需预定义集体变量且计算成本可接受的情况下重建转变路径。Gen-COMPAS将去噪扩散概率模型（该模型生成结构上合理的中间靶标）与基于通量器的过滤相结合，以识别转变态(4,5)。从这些中间体出发的短时无偏模拟，可在纳秒至亚微秒的聚合采样尺度上获得转变区域系综，而传统方法需要多个数量级的更多采样。应用于从小型蛋白质到五聚体配体门控离子通道的系统，Gen-COMPAS仅从已知端点结构恢复通量器、转变态和自由能景观，无需预定义反应坐标或先验机制知识，从而为迄今抵抗传统模拟方法的生物分子系统提供了一条计算上可行的机制洞察途径。

documents.title: Molecular characterization of vitellogenin and its receptor with CRISPR-based sgRNA validation in the legume pod borer, Maruca vitrata (Geyer) (Lepidoptera: Crambidae).
meta: Pradeep, Chalapathi; Sujatha, Parvathy Madhusoodanan; Nagesha, Somakalahalli Narasimhappa; Asokan, Ramasamy; Karuppannasamy, Ashok
Bulletin of entomological research
documents.summary: 该研究对豆荚螟卵黄原蛋白及其受体进行分子克隆、同源建模和蛋白-蛋白对接，并验证CRISPR sgRNA切割活性，虽涉及蛋白结构建模和对接，但核心是昆虫生殖基因功能表征与害虫防治，非蛋白质结构计算方法的创新性研究。
documents.abstract: Maruca vitrata, the legume pod borer, causes yield losses of up to 80% in grain legumes. Increasing insecticide resistance and environmental concerns necessitate sustainable pest management alternatives. In the present study, the complete vitellogenin (Vg) coding sequence (CDS), a key reproductive gene involved in oogenesis and embryonic development, was cloned and molecularly characterised from M. vitrata. The assembled Vg CDS ( approximately 5.3 kb) shared 99.04% sequence identity with the reported M. vitrata Vg sequence (MG799570.1). Phylogenetic analysis demonstrated close evolutionary association with related Lepidopteran species, while protein domain analysis identified three conserved domains, namely LPD_N, DUF1943, and VWD. Among these, the single exon-encoded LPD_N domain was selected as the target region for CRISPR/Cas9-mediated editing. Homology models of Vg and vitellogenin receptor (VgR) (Global Model Quality Estimation (GMQE): 0.58 and 0.51) showed a favourable interaction by protein-protein docking (score: -295.66). Three single-guide RNAs (sgRNAs) were designed, synthesised through in-vitro transcription, and evaluated using in vitro cleavage assays. sgRNA1 targeting the LPD_N domain and sgRNA2 targeting the signal peptide region exhibited efficient site-specific cleavage activity, whereas sgRNA3 failed to induce cleavage because of an unfavourable secondary structure that likely impaired Cas9-sgRNA complex formation. Overall, this study provides the first CRISPR-oriented functional characterisation and sgRNA validation of the M. vitrata Vg gene, together with structural characterisation of VgR and Vg-VgR interaction analysis, providing preliminary molecular resources for future CRISPR/Cas9 studies and supporting future embryo microinjection and heritable genome editing for sustainable management of M. vitrata. Maruca vitrata，即豆荚螟，对谷类豆科作物造成高达80%的产量损失。日益增长的杀虫剂抗性和环境问题促使需要可持续的害虫管理替代方案。在本研究中，从M. vitrata中克隆并分子表征了卵黄原蛋白（vitellogenin, Vg）的完整编码序列（CDS），这是一个参与卵子发生和胚胎发育的关键生殖基因。组装得到的Vg CDS（约5.3 kb）与已报道的M. vitrata Vg序列（MG799570.1）具有99.04%的序列一致性。系统发育分析显示其与相关鳞翅目物种存在密切的进化关联，而蛋白结构域分析鉴定出三个保守结构域，即LPD_N、DUF1943和VWD。其中，由单一外显子编码的LPD_N结构域被选为CRISPR/Cas9介导编辑的靶区域。Vg和卵黄原蛋白受体（vitellogenin receptor, VgR）的同源模型（全局模型质量估计（GMQE）：0.58和0.51）通过蛋白-蛋白对接显示出有利的相互作用（得分：-295.66）。设计并合成了三个单导向RNA（sgRNAs），通过体外转录合成，并使用体外切割实验进行评估。靶向LPD_N结构域的sgRNA1和靶向信号肽区域的sgRNA2表现出高效的位点特异性切割活性，而sgRNA3因不利的二级结构未能诱导切割，该结构可能损害了Cas9-sgRNA复合物的形成。总体而言，本研究提供了M. vitrata Vg基因的首次CRISPR导向功能表征和sgRNA验证，以及VgR的结构表征和Vg-VgR相互作用分析，为未来CRISPR/Cas9研究提供了初步分子资源，并支持未来胚胎显微注射和可遗传基因组编辑，以实现对M. vitrata的可持续管理。

documents.title: Deep DNA and protein level feature integration for robust clinical variant interpretation using probabilistic gradient boosting.
meta: Karthik, V; Prejesh, S; Kudale, Sumedh Deepak; OmKumar, Chandra Umakanthan
Frontiers in digital health
documents.summary: 该文使用概率梯度提升模型整合DNA和蛋白质特征进行变异致病性预测，虽涉及蛋白质特征但核心是变异分类而非蛋白质结构计算建模，方法为传统机器学习，与蛋白质结构预测/采样/生成等核心课题关系较弱。
documents.abstract: A major challenge in clinical genomics is to classify genetic variations correctly, since it directly affects disease diagnosis and personal care. The existing methods tend to be based on the combination of different factors, such as protein structure, population frequencies, phenotypic annotations, and sequence conservation. Nevertheless, these methods often cannot be used to achieve the necessary interpretability, quantify uncertainty, and address rare cases. This paper presents a probabilistic gradient boosting model on variant pathogenicity prediction. The suggested framework applies biological characteristics at both level of DNA and protein levels while also scaling the level of uncertainty in clinical decision making. Our machine learning aims to solve the issues of variant interpretation by managing the features and through probability-based pathogenicity prediction. The framework formulation is aimed at generalizing over various datasets and minimizing overfitting. At the same time, it can ensure reasonable performance to facilitate clinical experiments. The model has also been tested on three standard datasets and demonstrated to be more predictive of the pathogenic effect of variants, in comparison with a variety of existing tools. The probabilistic gradient boosting model proposed had ROC AUC values of 0.9293, 0.9610, and 0.9646 on ClinVar variants, GRCh37, and GRCh38 human genome respectively. Furthermore, the dataset was ensured to include both exonic and intronic variants, and Variants of Uncertain Significance were also taken into consideration for Performance Testing. Through this it also aims to provide better clinical significance which will lead to a good interpretable tool for priority of variants for a large variety of disease conditions. 临床基因组学中的一个主要挑战是正确分类遗传变异，因为这直接影响疾病诊断和个体化医疗。现有方法通常基于不同因素的组合，例如蛋白质结构、群体频率、表型注释和序列保守性。然而，这些方法往往无法实现必要的可解释性、量化不确定性，并处理罕见病例。本文提出了一种用于变异致病性预测的概率梯度提升模型。该框架在DNA和蛋白质两个层面应用生物学特征，同时缩放临床决策中的不确定性水平。我们的机器学习旨在通过管理特征和基于概率的致病性预测来解决变异解读问题。该框架的制定旨在泛化到各种数据集并最小化过拟合，同时确保合理的性能以促进临床实验。该模型已在三个标准数据集上进行了测试，与多种现有工具相比，在预测变异致病效应方面表现出更高的准确性。所提出的概率梯度提升模型在ClinVar变异、GRCh37和GRCh38人类基因组上的ROC AUC值分别为0.9293、0.9610和0.9646。此外，数据集确保包含外显子和内含子变异，并在性能测试中考虑了意义不明确的变异（Variants of Uncertain Significance）。通过这一点，该模型还旨在提供更好的临床意义，从而为多种疾病条件下的变异优先级排序提供一个良好的可解释工具。

documents.title: Benchmarking antibody modeling tools across structure prediction, docking, and paratope-epitope interface analysis.
meta: Yu, Zeyuan; Wu, Jilei; Ning, Ziyao; Qiao, Chunxia; Wang, Jing; Li, Xinying; Liu, Chenghua; Chen, Guojiang; Feng, Jiannan; Yu, Jijun
Bioinformatics advances
documents.summary: 该文系统比较了多种抗体结构预测、对接及界面分析工具的性能，虽为工程化评估而非方法创新，但直接涉及蛋白质结构预测、对接等核心计算问题，对本课题的工具选择与基准测试有参考价值。
documents.abstract: MOTIVATION: Computational antibody engineering requires reliable prediction of antibody variable-fragment structures, antigen-antibody complexes, and binding interfaces. However, publicly available tools for these tasks have rarely been compared across the complete workflow under a controlled and statistically grounded design. RESULTS: We evaluated ImmuneBuilder, IgFold, AlphaFold3, GRAMM, and dyMEAN on 50 non-redundant humanized antibody-antigen complexes using multiple retained predictions and paired statistical testing. All three antibody structure predictors were accurate, with AlphaFold3 performing best overall and for the third complementarity-determining region of the heavy chain. AlphaFold3 also substantially outperformed GRAMM and dyMEAN in complex prediction, producing medium- or high-quality binding interfaces for 46% of the complexes, although overall interface accuracy remained limited. When docking was reliable, AlphaFold3 accurately recovered epitope and paratope residues, salt bridges, and non-bonded contacts, but reproduced hydrogen bonds and fine-grained contact strengths less consistently. These findings provide practical guidance for selecting tools across antibody-modeling workflows and identify persistent limitations in fine-grained interface prediction. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Data, structural predictions, evaluation results, and analysis code are available from Zenodo under record 20710876. 动机：计算抗体工程需要对抗体可变区片段结构、抗原-抗体复合物及结合界面进行可靠预测。然而，针对这些任务的公开可用工具，在受控且具有统计基础的设计下，很少在整个工作流程中进行比较。结果：我们使用多个保留预测和配对统计检验，在50个非冗余人源化抗体-抗原复合物上评估了ImmuneBuilder、IgFold、AlphaFold3、GRAMM和dyMEAN。所有三种抗体结构预测器均表现准确，其中AlphaFold3整体表现最佳，且在重链第三互补决定区上表现最优。AlphaFold3在复合物预测方面也显著优于GRAMM和dyMEAN，为46%的复合物生成了中等或高质量的结合界面，尽管整体界面准确性仍然有限。当对接可靠时，AlphaFold3能准确恢复表位和互补位残基、盐桥及非键接触，但在氢键和细粒度接触强度的再现上一致性较差。这些发现为跨抗体建模工作流选择工具提供了实用指导，并识别出细粒度界面预测中持续存在的局限性。可用性与实现：数据、结构预测、评估结果及分析代码可从Zenodo（记录号20710876）获取。

documents.title: HighMorph: De Novo Cyclic Peptide Sequence Design via Protein-Protein Interaction Recapitulation.
meta: Lan, Minhui; Zhang, Chengyun; Wang, Wentong; Hu, Haomeng; Lin, Huitian; Cao, Sen; Guo, Jingjing; Duan, Hongliang
Journal of medicinal chemistry
documents.summary: 提出HighMorph框架，结合蒙特卡洛树搜索与Transformer策略-价值网络，利用蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用信息指导环肽序列从头设计，并在PD-L1和KLK4靶点上验证了高活性率。
documents.abstract: Cyclic peptides have emerged as a compelling class of bioactive scaffolds, but de novo design of target-binding cyclic peptides from protein structures remains challenging. Here, we present HighMorph, an interaction-guided framework that combines protein-protein interaction information with artificial intelligence for rational cyclic peptide design. HighMorph integrates Monte Carlo tree search with a Transformer-based policy-value network to efficiently explore cyclic peptide sequence space, while incorporating explicit atomic-level hydrogen bond constraints extracted from reference protein-protein complexes to guide sequence optimization. The framework is systematically validated on two clinically relevant targets, programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) and kallikrein-related peptidase 4 (KLK4). Notably, 33.3% and 40% of the generated candidates are active against PD-L1 and KLK4, respectively, with active cyclic peptides exhibiting micromolar binding affinities (approximately 10-6 M). These results validate our approach for cyclic peptide design. Additionally, interaction analysis provides insights for developing therapeutics targeting challenging protein interfaces. 环肽已成为一类引人注目的生物活性骨架，但从蛋白质结构从头设计靶标结合环肽仍具挑战。在此，我们提出HighMorph，一种将蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用信息与人工智能相结合的相互作用引导框架，用于合理设计环肽。HighMorph将蒙特卡洛树搜索与基于Transformer的策略-价值网络相结合，以高效探索环肽序列空间，同时整合从参考蛋白质-蛋白质复合物中提取的显式原子级氢键约束，以指导序列优化。该框架在两个临床相关靶标——程序性死亡配体1 (PD-L1) 和激肽释放酶相关肽酶4 (KLK4) 上得到系统验证。值得注意的是，33.3%和40%的生成候选物分别对PD-L1和KLK4具有活性，活性环肽表现出微摩尔级结合亲和力（约10⁻⁶ M）。这些结果验证了我们用于环肽设计的方法。此外，相互作用分析为开发针对挑战性蛋白质界面的治疗药物提供了见解。

documents.title: Gradient-based Optimization for mRNA Sequence Design.
meta: Li, Hongmin; Terai, Goro; Otagaki, Takumi; Asai, Kiyoshi
Bioinformatics (Oxford, England)
documents.summary: 该文提出ID3框架，利用梯度优化设计mRNA序列以优化翻译起始区RNA可及性和密码子适应指数，虽涉及序列设计但核心对象是mRNA而非蛋白质结构，方法上使用深度学习预测器进行可微优化，对蛋白质序列设计有间接启发。
documents.abstract: MOTIVATION: Designing mRNA coding sequences that simultaneously optimize RNA accessibility in the translation initiation region and codon adaptation while preserving the encoded protein requires navigating a vast discrete combinatorial space. The inherently discrete nature of codon choices prevents direct application of gradient-based optimization, despite the availability of accurate deep learning predictors such as DeepRaccess for RNA accessibility prediction. RESULTS: We present the Input Data Differentiable Designer (ID3), a unified framework for mRNA codon optimization. ID3 treats trained models as fixed differentiable functions and optimizes input data through continuous probability distributions while preserving the encoded amino acid sequence through three constraint mechanisms. The framework shows strong performance in both accessibility optimization and joint accessibility-CAI optimization across diverse protein targets. We also provide convergence analyses from the perspective of trained model input optimization. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Code, datasets, and reproduction scripts are available at https://github.com/Li-Hongmin/ID3.git and archived on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18917770). 动机：设计同时优化翻译起始区域RNA可及性和密码子适应性、同时保留编码蛋白质的mRNA编码序列，需要探索一个巨大的离散组合空间。密码子选择固有的离散性质使得基于梯度的优化无法直接应用，尽管已有诸如DeepRaccess等用于RNA可及性预测的准确深度学习预测器。结果：我们提出了输入数据可微设计器（Input Data Differentiable Designer, ID3），一个用于mRNA密码子优化的统一框架。ID3将训练好的模型视为固定的可微函数，通过连续概率分布优化输入数据，同时通过三种约束机制保留编码的氨基酸序列。该框架在多种蛋白质靶标的可及性优化以及可及性-密码子适应指数（CAI）联合优化中均表现出强劲性能。我们还从训练模型输入优化的角度提供了收敛性分析。可用性与实现：代码、数据集和复现脚本可在https://github.com/Li-Hongmin/ID3.git获取，并归档于Zenodo（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18917770）。

documents.title: Consensus design and in silico screening of GH42 beta-galactosidase for enhanced catalytic hydrolysis of whey lactose.
meta: Ding, Simeng; Li, Jiajia; Li, Jiahui; Nie, Huayu; Li, Yongxin; Guo, Zheng; Gao, Renjun
Journal of dairy science
documents.summary: 该文通过共识设计和虚拟筛选对GH42 β-半乳糖苷酶进行工程改造，结合MD模拟揭示结构机制，虽以酶工程应用为主，但涉及蛋白质结构计算（MD模拟、虚拟筛选）和结构-功能关系分析，对蛋白质结构设计有参考价值。
documents.abstract: This study addresses a major bottleneck in dairy waste management by engineering a highly efficient, thermophilic enzyme for lactose hydrolysis, transforming the cheese manufacturing by-product whey into a high-value resource. While traditional glycoside hydrolase family 2 (GH2) enzymes suffer from poor industrial thermostability, thermophilic GH42 alternatives lack the catalytic efficiency required for practical processing. To bridge this gap, a synergistic engineering strategy combining consensus sequence design and virtual binding energy screening was applied to Tn1577, a home-discovered GH42-galactosidase from Thermotoga naphthophila RUK10. Through homologous sequence analysis and iterative saturation mutagenesis, a superior triple mutant designated M10 (H271Q/V357G/Q340E) was successfully developed. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations revealed that M10s performance is driven by 3 key structural alterations. First, a remodeled substrate tunnel accelerates lactose entry and product release while minimizing molecular congestion in the active cavity. Second, consensus mutations rigidify the catalytic pocket to preserve its geometry under thermal stress. Finally, a distal Q340E mutation rearranges local hydrogen bonding and forms a new anion-pi interaction, anchoring the protein backbone to stabilize the overall conformation via allosteric regulation. This engineered rigidity introduces a beneficial kinetic trade-off: it drastically accelerates catalytic turnover by intentionally weakening substrate affinity, preventing enzyme stagnation and ensuring continuous catalytic cycling. Consequently, mutant M10 achieves a remarkable 6.5-fold increase in lactose hydrolysis activity at 55 degrees C compared with the wild-type enzyme. Response surface methodology established ideal industrial parameters: 52.7 degrees C, pH 5.5, and an enzyme dosage of 2.9 U/mL. Under these conditions, M10 accomplishes near-complete lactose hydrolysis of raw whey within a brief 2-h window. Operating at a temperature below the thermal unfolding point of core whey proteins ( approximately 60 degrees C), this mild thermal regimen shortens processing times and prevents the thermal denaturation of other valuable whey components, demonstrating M10s immense potential for high-efficiency, stable lactose-free dairy processing. 本研究通过工程化一种高效的热稳定酶用于乳糖水解，解决了乳品废弃物管理中的重大瓶颈，将奶酪制造副产物乳清转化为高价值资源。传统糖苷水解酶家族2 (GH2) 酶因工业热稳定性差而受限，而热稳定的GH42替代酶则缺乏实际加工所需的催化效率。为弥合这一差距，本研究将共识序列设计与虚拟结合能筛选相结合的协同工程策略应用于Tn1577，这是一种从Thermotoga naphthophila RUK10中自行发现的GH42-半乳糖苷酶。通过同源序列分析和迭代饱和突变，成功开发出命名为M10的优越三重突变体（H271Q/V357G/Q340E）。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟揭示，M10的性能由3个关键结构改变驱动。首先，重塑的底物通道加速了乳糖进入和产物释放，同时减少了活性腔内的分子拥挤。其次，共识突变使催化口袋刚性化，以在热应力下保持其几何结构。最后，远端Q340E突变重排了局部氢键网络，并形成新的阴离子-π相互作用，通过变构调控锚定蛋白质骨架以稳定整体构象。这种工程化刚性引入了一种有益的动力学权衡：通过有意削弱底物亲和力，大幅加速催化周转，防止酶停滞并确保持续的催化循环。因此，突变体M10在55摄氏度下实现了与野生型酶相比6.5倍的乳糖水解活性提升。响应面法确定了理想的工业参数：52.7摄氏度、pH 5.5、酶用量2.9 U/mL。在这些条件下，M10在短短2小时内实现了对原料乳清中乳糖的近完全水解。在低于核心乳清蛋白热解折叠点（约60摄氏度）的温度下运行，这种温和的热处理方案缩短了加工时间，并防止了其他有价值乳清组分的热变性，展示了M10在高效率、稳定无乳糖乳品加工中的巨大潜力。

documents.title: uFlowCSP: Crystal Structure Prediction using Mean flow generative models
meta: Sourin Dey; Dipannoy Das Gupta; Lai Wei; Sadman Sadeed Omee; Jianjun Hu
arXiv
documents.summary: 提出基于MeanFlow的晶体结构预测模型uFlowCSP，虽对象为晶体而非蛋白质，但其高效生成结构和对称性感知的Transformer架构对蛋白质构象生成与结构预测有方法借鉴意义。
documents.abstract: Crystal structure prediction (CSP) is fundamental to computational materials discovery. Generative models including CDVAE, DiffCSP, FlowMM, and CrystalFlow learn stable-crystal distributions directly, but diffusion and flow-matching inference requires tens to thousands of sequential network evaluations per candidate. We introduce uFlowCSP, a MeanFlow-based CSP model that learns the average, rather than instantaneous, probability-flow velocity. It generates a complete structure in one to five evaluations, delivering 5x-58x faster inference with equal or better performance. A chemistry- and symmetry-aware Transformer uses canonical atom ordering, global composition, and per-token chemistry embeddings. A coarse crystal-system token is used only during training; it provides additive gains, particularly improving space-group agreement despite being absent at inference, which remains formula-only. On MP-20 with 20 candidates per target, one step matches CrystalFlow (78.38% vs. 78.34%) with 100x fewer evaluations and about 10x lower wall-clock time. Five steps reach 83.64%, exceeding CrystalFlow (78.34% at 2,000 evaluations) and DiffCSP (77.93% at about 20,000), while using 20x fewer evaluations. uFlowCSP generates 10,000 structures in 0.39-1.31 minutes, versus 6.5 for CrystalFlow and 76.1 for DiffCSP. Under CSPBench's energy-ranked top-five structure-and-space-group criterion, five-step uFlowCSP reaches 72%/72%/65% structure, space-group, and consensus match rates. CrystalFlow reaches 78%/73%/68% at 100 steps but falls to 49%/32%/31% at five. Thus, uFlowCSP improves accuracy per network evaluation, not merely peak accuracy. 晶体结构预测（Crystal structure prediction, CSP）是计算材料发现的基础。生成模型（包括CDVAE、DiffCSP、FlowMM和CrystalFlow）直接学习稳定晶体的分布，但扩散和流匹配推理每个候选结构需要数十到数千次顺序网络评估。我们提出uFlowCSP，一种基于MeanFlow的CSP模型，它学习平均（而非瞬时）概率流速度。该模型在一次到五次评估内生成完整结构，推理速度提升5倍至58倍，性能相当或更优。一种化学与对称性感知的Transformer使用规范原子排序、全局组成和每个token的化学嵌入。粗粒度晶体系统token仅在训练期间使用；它提供附加增益，特别是在推理时（仅基于化学式）缺失的情况下仍能改善空间群一致性。在MP-20数据集上，每个目标20个候选结构时，单步评估匹配CrystalFlow（78.38% vs. 78.34%），评估次数减少100倍，实际时间降低约10倍。五步评估达到83.64%，超过CrystalFlow（2,000次评估时78.34%）和DiffCSP（约20,000次评估时77.93%），同时评估次数减少20倍。uFlowCSP在0.39-1.31分钟内生成10,000个结构，而CrystalFlow需6.5分钟，DiffCSP需76.1分钟。在CSPBench的能量排序前五结构与空间群准则下，五步uFlowCSP达到72%/72%/65%的结构、空间群和共识匹配率。CrystalFlow在100步时达到78%/73%/68%，但在五步时降至49%/32%/31%。因此，uFlowCSP提升的是每次网络评估的精度，而不仅仅是峰值精度。

documents.title: Zero-shot rib design: merging training-free generative prior with topology optimization
meta: Yongmin Kwon; Namwoo Kang
arXiv
documents.summary: 该文将文本到图像扩散模型与拓扑优化结合用于结构设计，虽涉及生成模型和物理优化，但对象为工程结构而非蛋白质，且未涉及蛋白质结构计算问题，仅算法框架对蛋白结构设计有潜在启发。
documents.abstract: Natural load-bearing patterns such as leaf venation, trabecular bone, and spider webs achieve high stiffness per unit mass, yet classical topology optimizers rarely reach such geometries, and few let engineers express structural design intent through natural language. This work treats a frozen text-to-image diffusion model as a training-free source of design knowledge and distills it into the physics loop of density-based topology optimization via score distillation sampling, so that a text prompt becomes an explicit, machine-interpretable representation of engineer intent. The prompt-induced generative gradient and the finite element sensitivity are combined at every iteration, letting physics decide which prompt-induced features survive. In 245 primary SDS runs spanning four geometric domains and two physics regimes, 38 of 49 prompt--domain combinations achieved statistically significant compliance reductions (up to $-31.5\%$ mechanical and $-23.0\%$ thermoelastic), outperforming gradient-based baselines. Cross-domain morphological analysis identifies a recurring structural signature of improvement: in most domains the generative prior suppresses dead-end branches in the rib skeleton, with endpoint--compliance correlation $r = +0.56$ to $+0.99$. A Heaviside projection with $β$-continuation resolves a pronounced intermediate-density tendency in this diffusion--physics coupling ($42.6\%$ to $<3\%$), and an automated skeleton-based pipeline converts optimized density fields into \rev{candidate geometry ready for computer-aided design. By retargeting the generative prior across domains, loading conditions, and physics objectives through a change of text prompt, with each new problem's physics setup specified separately, the framework uses a pretrained generative model as a reusable, training-free prior for engineering design. 天然承力模式，如叶脉 (leaf venation)、骨小梁 (trabecular bone) 和蜘蛛网 (spider web)，能够实现单位质量下的高刚度，然而经典拓扑优化器很少能达到此类几何构型，且鲜有方法允许工程师通过自然语言表达结构设计意图。本工作将冻结的文本到图像扩散模型 (frozen text-to-image diffusion model) 视为无需训练的设计知识来源，并通过分数蒸馏采样 (score distillation sampling) 将其蒸馏到基于密度的拓扑优化 (density-based topology optimization) 的物理循环中，从而使文本提示 (text prompt) 成为工程师意图的显式、机器可解释的表示。在每次迭代中，提示诱导的生成梯度与有限元灵敏度 (finite element sensitivity) 相结合，让物理过程决定哪些提示诱导的特征得以保留。在跨越四个几何域和两个物理机制的245次主SDS运行中，49个提示-域组合中有38个实现了统计上显著的柔度降低（机械方面高达$-31.5\%$，热弹性方面高达$-23.0\%$），优于基于梯度的基线方法。跨域形态分析识别出一个反复出现的改进结构特征：在大多数域中，生成先验 (generative prior) 抑制了肋骨架 (rib skeleton) 中的末端分支，端点-柔度相关性 $r = +0.56$ 至 $+0.99$。采用带有 $β$-延续 (β-continuation) 的Heaviside投影 (Heaviside projection) 解决了这种扩散-物理耦合中显著的中等密度倾向（从$42.6\%$降至$<3\%$），并且一个基于骨架的自动化流程将优化后的密度场转换为适用于计算机辅助设计 (computer-aided design) 的候选几何。通过改变文本提示来跨域、跨载荷条件和跨物理目标重新定向生成先验，同时每个新问题的物理设置单独指定，该框架将预训练生成模型用作工程设计中的可重用、无需训练的先验。

documents.title: De novo Rubisco design with protein language models
meta: Alexander J. Kehl; Simon K. S. Chu; Jose Henrique Pereira; Jennifer Lee; Renee Z. Wang; Michael Gigl; Paul D. Adams; Patrick M. Shih; Justin B. Siegel
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文利用蛋白质语言模型（ProGen-2和ESM-2）从头设计Rubisco酶，生成大量新序列并验证了活性与结构，核心贡献在蛋白质结构相关的序列设计与结构预测，方法为AI深度学习，与本课题高度相关。
documents.abstract: Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase (‘Rubisco’) fixes the majority of carbon dioxide globally but is challenged with low specificity for CO 2 versus O 2 and low catalytic efficiencies. Traditional engineering efforts have remained difficult because folding, assembly, specificity, and catalysis are tightly coupled, hampering efforts to explore sequence space. Therefore, we leveraged recent advances in protein large language models (PLMs) to generate sequences beyond those observed in nature, using both ProGen-2 that was fine-tuned on a limited dataset of non-Form I Rubiscos and an ESM-2 discriminator. With this approach, we generated 5.6 million novel Rubisco-like sequences and identified 21 highly diverse candidates predicted to be active that occupy regions of Rubisco phylogenetic space not previously observed in nature. Six designs were soluble in Escherichia coli , and five were shown to produce quantifiable 3PGA. One design produced an apparent CO 2 /O 2 specificity estimate beyond the range of the natural representative Rubiscos assayed. We also solved the crystal structure of one de novo design that reproduced the predicted dimer and active-site geometry with sub-angstrom Cα agreement. Sequence-only generation followed by independent structural filtering therefore recovered soluble, active Rubiscos from regions of sequence space that are not represented in genomic databases. Together, these results establish a scalable strategy for accessing previously unexplored Rubisco sequence space, providing a broadly accessible path toward generating de novo Rubiscos that have activity and specificity parameters needed to address longstanding limitations in biological carbon fixation. 核酮糖-1,5-二磷酸羧化酶/加氧酶（'Rubisco'）固定了全球大部分的二氧化碳，但面临对CO₂与O₂的低特异性以及低催化效率的挑战。传统的工程改造尝试一直困难重重，因为折叠、组装、特异性和催化过程紧密耦合，阻碍了对序列空间的探索。因此，我们利用蛋白质大语言模型（PLMs）的最新进展，生成了超越自然界中观察到的序列，使用了在非Form I型Rubisco的有限数据集上微调的ProGen-2以及一个ESM-2判别器。通过这种方法，我们生成了560万个新型Rubisco样序列，并识别出21个预测具有活性的高度多样化候选序列，这些序列占据了Rubisco系统发育空间中此前在自然界中未观察到的区域。其中6个设计在大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）中可溶，5个被证明能产生可量化的3PGA。一个设计产生的表观CO₂/O₂特异性估计值超出了所测天然代表性Rubisco的范围。我们还解析了一个从头设计的晶体结构，该结构以亚埃级Cα一致性再现了预测的二聚体和活性位点几何构型。因此，仅通过序列生成再经独立结构过滤，便从基因组数据库中未代表的序列空间区域恢复了可溶、有活性的Rubisco。这些结果共同建立了一种可扩展的策略，用于探索此前未涉足的Rubisco序列空间，为生成具有解决生物碳固定中长期限制所需活性和特异性参数的从头Rubisco提供了一条广泛可行的路径。

documents.title: Empirical Geometry-Guided Modeling Enables Robust, High-Throughput Collagen Structure Prediction
meta: Howard B; Bauer M; Buehler MJ
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文针对胶原蛋白这一高度约束的蛋白质结构，开发了基于经验几何参数化的确定性结构预测模型CDSM，在保持较高精度的同时大幅降低计算成本，与AlphaFold等深度学习模型形成互补，属于蛋白质结构预测领域的方法创新。
documents.abstract:
ABSTRACT

Protein structure prediction is increasingly dominated by large learned generative models, yet for proteins governed by strong structural constraints, much of the relevant conformational space may be captured by substantially more compact representations. Collagen provides a compelling test case: its repeating Gly-X-Y sequence, restricted backbone conformations, and conserved triple-helical topology define a highly constrained structural manifold. Here, we develop a Collagen-specific Deterministic Structure Modeler (CDSM), extending the empirical geometric parameterization of THeBuScr into a robust, all-atom structure-prediction pipeline, and benchmark it against AlphaFold 3, Boltz-2, Chai-1, and Protenix-v1 on 80 experimentally resolved collagen triple-helical structures. CDSM increases coverage of this benchmark from 8.8% for native THeBuScr to 93.8%. Across the 75 structures successfully predicted by all methods, CDSM closely reproduces experimental backbone and global geometry, with fewer large-error predictions, while the learned models achieve modestly higher local and side-chain accuracy. When evaluated only on structures deposited after each learned model’s training-data cutoff, CDSM becomes more competitive, with aggregate win rates increasing from 29% to 55% for TM-score and from 40% to 65% for backbone RMSD, while CDSM performance remains comparatively stable across the same subsets. CDSM generates structures in 2.4 s on a single CPU core at approximately $3 × 10 −5 per structure, making it 400 to 790× cheaper than the learned methods even when each is run on its lowest-cost compatible GPU. These results demonstrate how identifying and explicitly encoding relevant geometric constraints can dramatically compress a structure-prediction problem, retaining much of the accuracy at orders-of-magnitude lower computational cost. More broadly, CDSM illustrates the potential for compact, executable scientific representations that complement large learned models, and motivates future AI-driven searches over algorithms, representations, and empirical parameterizations to discover and continually refine such models for other structural protein domains.

摘要

蛋白质结构预测日益由大型学习生成模型主导，但对于受强结构约束的蛋白质而言，大量相关构象空间可能通过更紧凑的表示来捕捉。胶原蛋白提供了一个引人注目的测试案例：其重复的Gly-X-Y序列、受限的主链构象以及保守的三螺旋拓扑结构定义了一个高度受限的结构流形。在此，我们开发了一种胶原蛋白特异性确定性结构建模器（CDSM），将THeBuScr的经验几何参数化扩展为一个稳健的全原子结构预测流程，并在80个实验解析的胶原蛋白三螺旋结构上，将其与AlphaFold 3、Boltz-2、Chai-1和Protenix-v1进行基准测试。CDSM将该基准测试的覆盖率从原生THeBuScr的8.8%提升至93.8%。在所有方法成功预测的75个结构中，CDSM紧密再现了实验主链和全局几何结构，且大误差预测更少，而学习模型在局部和侧链精度上略高。当仅对每个学习模型训练数据截止日期后沉积的结构进行评估时，CDSM变得更具竞争力，TM-score的总体胜率从29%提升至55%，主链RMSD的总体胜率从40%提升至65%，而CDSM在相同子集上的性能保持相对稳定。CDSM在单个CPU核心上生成结构仅需2.4秒，每个结构成本约为$3 × 10^{-5}$，即使每种方法在其最低成本兼容GPU上运行，也比学习模型便宜400至790倍。这些结果表明，识别并显式编码相关几何约束可以大幅压缩结构预测问题，在数量级更低的计算成本下保留大部分准确性。更广泛地说，CDSM展示了紧凑、可执行的科学表示在补充大型学习模型方面的潜力，并激励未来基于AI的算法、表示和经验参数化搜索，以发现并持续改进其他结构蛋白结构域的这种模型。

documents.title: Predicted and experimental protein-ligand coordinates with distance labels and evaluation splits
meta: Klamt T
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文构建了蛋白-配体结构预测的基准数据集PLI-Parallax，包含预测与实验坐标及置信度校准，虽非新方法但为蛋白质结构计算评估提供了关键资源，与本课题相关。
documents.abstract: Structure prediction tools now provide protein–ligand geometry for pairs no laboratory experiment has resolved thus far. This data is typically provided without calibrated, practically usable per-system measures of whether a given complex is correct and how much to trust it. Agreement between independently constructed methods is an established signal for this type of problem. What has been missing is a way to derive what a given level of agreement is worth. We present PLI-Parallax, which deposits predicted geometry together with experimental data needed to calibrate it. Chai-1, two Boltz-2 configurations, and the docking engine smina were run over shared inputs across an experimentally resolved crystal tier of 19,350 complexes and a corpus tier of 31,746 cross-docked pairs without experimental ground truth on predicted receptors, yielding 307,314,646 residue-to-ligand-atom distance records, which the stored coordinates allow a consumer to recompute at a cutoff of their own choosing. Their mutual agreement is fitted against observed accuracy where experimental data permits it and carried to where it does not. This way 30,567 systems carry predicted label accuracy together with a split-conformal interval. On the crystal tier that interval covers observed accuracy at the stated rate. On the corpus tier it ranks systems by expected label quality, since both distributions differ. The deposit is accompanied by 646 evaluation configurations across seven data split families, and 631 of them report how far their training and test entities separate under a two-sample test. The 906 protein accessions were partitioned to control sequence leakage, so a protein-cold split here tests generalisation across sequence space. The two tiers support evaluation against experimental data and, where this is absent, supervision weighted by how far the configurations agree. 结构预测工具现在能够提供实验室实验尚未解析的蛋白质-配体几何结构。这些数据通常缺乏经过校准的、实际可用的系统级度量，以判断给定复合物是否正确及其可信程度。独立构建的方法之间的一致性是该类问题的一个既定信号。缺失的是一种方法，用以推导特定一致性水平的价值。我们提出PLI-Parallax，它将预测几何结构与校准所需的实验数据一同存储。Chai-1、两种Boltz-2配置以及对接引擎smina在共享输入上运行，覆盖了19,350个复合物的实验解析晶体层和31,746个无实验真值的预测受体交叉对接对语料层，产生了307,314,646条残基到配体原子的距离记录，存储的坐标允许使用者自行选择截断值重新计算这些记录。它们之间的一致性在实验数据允许的情况下与观测准确率进行拟合，并推广到无实验数据的场景。这样，30,567个系统携带预测标签准确率及分裂共形区间。在晶体层，该区间以所述速率覆盖观测准确率；在语料层，由于两个分布不同，它按预期标签质量对系统进行排序。该存储伴随七个数据分割家族的646个评估配置，其中631个报告了在双样本检验下训练和测试实体分离的程度。906个蛋白质登录号被分区以控制序列泄漏，因此这里的蛋白质冷分割测试了跨序列空间的泛化能力。这两个层支持针对实验数据的评估，并在缺乏实验数据时，根据配置一致程度进行加权监督。

documents.title: Data-driven strategies for enzyme engineering: From machine learning to protein language models
meta: Shaozhen Ding; Peng Wu; Shubo Li; Yuxuan Yang; Han Zhu; Heng Yu; Yu Tian; Dachuan Zhang; Qian-Nan Hu
ChemRxiv
documents.summary: 该综述总结了酶工程中从机器学习到蛋白语言模型的计算策略，涵盖酶发现、性质预测、从头设计和优化，虽以酶为对象但涉及结构预测与设计，方法上包含AI模型，但偏重综述且非核心结构计算创新。
documents.abstract: Enzymes are key biocatalysts that drive diverse biological processes and industrial applications, offering sustainable alternatives to conventional chemical catalysis. However, the enormous enzyme sequence space and the limited functional annotation have created an urgent demand for computational approaches to accelerate enzyme discovery and engineering. Recent advances in computational methods are accelerating enzyme engineering from empirical trial and error toward predictive design. This review summarizes representative computational tools and predictive models in the enzyme engineering workflow, including (1) enzyme data resources, (2) functional enzyme discovery, (3) enzyme property prediction (e.g., kinetics, optimal temperature and PH, solubility, promiscuity, and specificity), (4) de novo enzyme design, and (5) computationally guided enzyme optimization. We further compare current computational strategies, discuss their strengths and limitations in different engineering scenarios, and highlight emerging trends toward foundation models, generative artificial intelligence, multimodal learning, and closed-loop design–build–test–learn platforms. 酶是关键的生物催化剂，驱动着多样的生物学过程和工业应用，为传统化学催化提供了可持续的替代方案。然而，巨大的酶序列空间 (enzyme sequence space) 和有限的功能注释 (functional annotation) 催生了对计算方法加速酶发现与工程化的迫切需求。计算方法的近期进展正将酶工程从经验性的试错法推向预测性设计。本综述总结了酶工程工作流中具有代表性的计算工具和预测模型，包括：(1) 酶数据资源 (enzyme data resources)，(2) 功能性酶发现 (functional enzyme discovery)，(3) 酶性质预测 (enzyme property prediction)（例如动力学 (kinetics)、最适温度和pH (optimal temperature and pH)、溶解度 (solubility)、底物混杂性 (promiscuity) 和特异性 (specificity)），(4) 从头酶设计 (de novo enzyme design)，以及 (5) 计算引导的酶优化 (computationally guided enzyme optimization)。我们进一步比较了当前的计算策略，讨论了它们在不同工程场景中的优势与局限，并强调了向基础模型 (foundation models)、生成式人工智能 (generative artificial intelligence)、多模态学习 (multimodal learning) 和闭环设计–构建–测试–学习平台 (closed-loop design–build–test–learn platforms) 发展的新兴趋势。

documents.title: ESMDynamic: Fast and accurate prediction of protein dynamic contact maps from single sequences.
meta: Kleiman, Diego E; Feng, Jiangyan; Xue, Zhengyuan; Shukla, Diwakar
Nature communications
documents.summary: 该文提出ESMDynamic，基于ESMFold架构从单序列直接预测蛋白质动态接触图，结合实验构象系综和MD模拟训练，实现了高效、可扩展的构象动态预测，对蛋白质结构计算（构象采样、动态分析）有直接贡献。
documents.abstract: Understanding conformational dynamics is essential for elucidating protein function, yet most deep learning models in structural biology predict only static structures. Here, we present ESMDynamic, a deep learning model that predicts residue-residue contact dynamics directly from protein sequence. Built on the ESMFold architecture and trained on conformational variability from experimental structure ensembles and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, ESMDynamic predicts dynamic contact probabilities, contact occupancy fraction, and coarse-grained kinetics of contact formation and dissociation across multiple temperature conditions. On large-scale MD benchmarks (mdCATH and ATLAS), ESMDynamic matches or outperforms state-of-the-art ensemble prediction methods (AlphaFlow, ESMFlow, BioEmu) while requiring orders-of-magnitude less computation. We demonstrate generalization to diverse systems, including membrane transporters, a de novo designed protein, and a homodimer complex. We show that predicted dynamic contacts enable automated selection of collective variables for Markov state model construction. Applied to the human proteome, ESMDynamic generates predictions for over 18,000 proteins, enabling large-scale analysis of conformational variability. Overall, ESMDynamic provides a scalable, sequence-based representation of protein dynamics to inform simulation, analysis, and design workflows. 理解构象动态对于阐明蛋白质功能至关重要，然而结构生物学中的大多数深度学习模型仅预测静态结构。在此，我们提出ESMDynamic，一种直接从蛋白质序列预测残基-残基接触动态的深度学习模型。该模型基于ESMFold架构，并利用来自实验结构集合和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟的构象变异性进行训练，可预测动态接触概率、接触占据分数，以及多种温度条件下接触形成和解离的粗粒度动力学。在大规模MD基准测试（mdCATH和ATLAS）上，ESMDynamic匹配或超越了最先进的集合预测方法（AlphaFlow、ESMFlow、BioEmu），同时所需计算量低数个数量级。我们展示了其对多种系统的泛化能力，包括膜转运蛋白、一种从头设计的蛋白质以及一个同源二聚体复合物。我们表明，预测的动态接触能够实现马尔可夫状态模型构建中集体变量的自动选择。应用于人类蛋白质组时，ESMDynamic为超过18,000种蛋白质生成预测，从而支持大规模构象变异性分析。总体而言，ESMDynamic提供了一种可扩展的、基于序列的蛋白质动态表示，以指导模拟、分析和设计工作流程。

documents.title: Supervised Protein Structure Classification Using Topological Persistence With DeltaFold.
meta: Nardin-Gennequin, Joseph; Ciuperca, Gabriela; Brochier-Armanet, Celine; Malbos, Philippe
Proteins
documents.summary: 本文利用拓扑持久性同源性对DeltaFold预测的蛋白质结构进行编码，并训练机器学习模型实现快速、无需对齐的结构分类，属于蛋白质结构计算分析的应用，但方法创新性有限。
documents.abstract: Recent advances in protein structure prediction have considerably increased the number of available structures, underscoring the need for scalable and accurate methods to compare and classify this huge amount of data. Current approaches based on sequence alignment or structural superposition often lack sensitivity and/or are computationally expensive. Here, we introduce the DeltaFold Classifier (DFC), a fast, alignment-free, protein structure classification pipeline based on topological data analysis. Protein three-dimensional structures are encoded using fixed-length vectors derived from persistent homology applied to point clouds of their spatial representation. These vectors, known as Biotopological Markers (BTMs), capture the intrinsic topological features of protein structure geometry-such as cycles and cavities-across multiple spatial scales. BTMs are invariant under translations and rotations, thereby avoiding the need for structural superposition. The DFC pipeline uses the features of these BTMs to train machine learning models for protein structure classification at various hierarchical levels defined in the SCOP and CATH classifications. It achieves performance comparable to that of structure-based comparison methods while substantially improving computational efficiency. It also outperforms sequence-based methods in tasks involving distant homology detection. In-depth analyses confirm that most BTM features contribute significantly to classification performance. These findings highlight the potential of topological vectorisations in structural bioinformatics and support the DFC pipeline as an effective and scalable tool for automated protein structure classification and annotation. 近年来，蛋白质结构预测的进展显著增加了可用结构的数量，凸显了对可扩展且精确的方法来比较和分类这一海量数据的需求。当前基于序列比对或结构叠加的方法往往缺乏灵敏度，且/或计算成本高昂。在此，我们介绍DeltaFold分类器（DFC），这是一种基于拓扑数据分析的快速、免比对蛋白质结构分类流程。蛋白质三维结构通过固定长度向量进行编码，这些向量源自对其空间表示的点云应用持续同调（persistent homology）。这些向量被称为生物拓扑标记（BTMs），能够捕捉蛋白质结构几何的内在拓扑特征——如环和空腔——跨越多个空间尺度。BTMs在平移和旋转下保持不变，从而避免了结构叠加的需求。DFC流程利用这些BTMs的特征来训练机器学习模型，用于在SCOP和CATH分类中定义的多个层级上进行蛋白质结构分类。它在实现与基于结构比较方法相当的性能的同时，显著提高了计算效率。在涉及远距离同源检测的任务中，它也优于基于序列的方法。深入分析证实，大多数BTM特征对分类性能有显著贡献。这些发现突显了拓扑向量化在结构生物信息学中的潜力，并支持DFC流程作为自动化蛋白质结构分类和注释的有效且可扩展的工具。

documents.title: Molecular modeling design of antitrypanosomal pyrazolone derivatives targeting Chagas disease: QSAR, docking, molecular dynamics and free energy calculations.
meta: Sousa, Karen Karla F; Barbosa, Ana Beatriz S; Cardoso, Fabio Jose B; Silva, Jose Rogerio A; Molfetta, Fabio A
Journal of molecular modeling
documents.summary: 该文针对查加斯病靶点cruzain，采用QSAR、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和自由能计算设计抗锥虫吡唑酮衍生物，虽以蛋白质为对象并涉及结构计算，但方法偏传统物理模拟且问题聚焦药物设计而非蛋白质结构计算核心创新，对蛋白质结构计算课题启发有限。
documents.abstract:
CONTEXT: Chagas disease, caused by T. cruzi, remains a neglected tropical disease with limited therapeutic options, underscoring the urgent need for novel antitrypanosomal agents. A computer-aided drug design (CADD) protocol was applied to investigate pyrazolone derivatives with reported antitrypanosomal activity and their putative interaction with cruzain (Cz), a cysteine protease essential for parasite survival. A 2D-QSAR model built from a curated set of 33 phenyl-dihydropyrazolone derivatives guided the design of four new candidates (LMM1-LMM4), which showed intermediate predicted antitrypanosomal activity within the chemical space of the original pyrazolone series. Molecular docking identified favorable binding within the Cz active site, with contacts at residues Ser61, Gly66, and Leu67. MD simulations indicated overall structural stability of the protein-ligand complexes and revealed ligand-dependent conformational behavior within the Cz binding site. MM/GBSA calculations suggested that van der Waals interactions are major contributors to the computed binding energies; however, the MM/GBSA ranking did not fully reproduce the phenotypic antitrypanosomal activity trend. Per-residue decomposition and free energy landscape analyses were therefore interpreted qualitatively, suggesting that contacts with S2/S3 subsite residues and conformational adaptability may contribute to Cz recognition but do not, alone, explain whole-cell potency. These findings support pyrazolones as antitrypanosomal scaffolds and provide structural hypotheses for future experimental validation against Cz. METHODS: Molecular geometries were optimized at the PM6 level (MOPAC2016); descriptors were calculated with ChemDes and UseGalaxy, selected via OPS and a genetic algorithm (QSARINS), and the QSAR model was built using PLS regression (QSAR modeling software). Molecular docking was performed with GOLD, FITTED, and AutoDock Vina 1.2.3 against Cz (PDB: 3KKU). ADMET properties were predicted using OSIRIS Property Explorer, SwissADME, and ADMET-AI. Partial atomic charges were derived at the HF/6-31G* level with RESP fitting (Gaussian 09); MD simulations (3 x 250 ns per system) were run with AMBER20 using GAFF/ff14SB force fields and TIP3P solvent. Binding free energies were calculated by MM/GBSA (MMPBSA.py). 背景：由克氏锥虫（T. cruzi）引起的恰加斯病（Chagas disease）仍是一种被忽视的热带病，治疗选择有限，凸显了对新型抗锥虫药物的迫切需求。采用计算机辅助药物设计（CADD）方案，研究具有报道抗锥虫活性的吡唑啉酮衍生物及其与克鲁辛（cruzain, Cz）——一种对寄生虫生存至关重要的半胱氨酸蛋白酶——的假定相互作用。基于一组精选的33个苯基二氢吡唑啉酮衍生物构建的2D-QSAR模型，指导了四个新候选化合物（LMM1-LMM4）的设计，这些化合物在原始吡唑啉酮系列的化学空间中显示出中等预测抗锥虫活性。分子对接确定了在Cz活性位点内的有利结合，接触残基为Ser61、Gly66和Leu67。分子动力学（MD）模拟表明蛋白质-配体复合物整体结构稳定，并揭示了Cz结合位点内配体依赖性构象行为。MM/GBSA计算表明，范德华相互作用是计算结合能的主要贡献者；然而，MM/GBSA排序并未完全重现表型抗锥虫活性趋势。因此，对逐残基分解和自由能景观分析进行了定性解释，提示与S2/S3亚位点残基的接触和构象适应性可能有助于Cz识别，但单独并不足以解释全细胞效力。这些发现支持吡唑啉酮作为抗锥虫骨架，并为未来针对Cz的实验验证提供了结构假设。

方法：分子几何结构在PM6水平（MOPAC2016）下优化；描述符使用ChemDes和UseGalaxy计算，通过OPS和遗传算法（QSARINS）选择，并使用偏最小二乘（PLS）回归（QSAR建模软件）构建QSAR模型。分子对接使用GOLD、FITTED和AutoDock Vina 1.2.3针对Cz（PDB: 3KKU）进行。ADMET性质使用OSIRIS Property Explorer、SwissADME和ADMET-AI预测。部分原子电荷在HF/6-31G*水平下通过RESP拟合（Gaussian 09）获得；MD模拟（每个系统3 x 250 ns）使用AMBER20，采用GAFF/ff14SB力场和TIP3P溶剂。结合自由能通过MM/GBSA（MMPBSA.py）计算。

documents.title: Gating crosstalk in potassium channels.
meta: Hu, Lyubin; de Groot, Bert L; Gu, Ruo-Xu
Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
documents.summary: 该文通过分子动力学模拟研究钾通道中中央腔门控与选择性滤过器门控之间的变构耦合机制，揭示了腔水合和滤过器入口大小对离子渗透的协同调控，属于蛋白质结构相关的计算模拟研究，方法上使用MD模拟，问题聚焦于构象变化与门控机制，对象为蛋白质通道，综合评分高。
documents.abstract: Ion permeation through potassium channels is regulated by multiple gates. In particular, conformational changes in the central cavity (the activation gate) can propagate to the selectivity filter (an inactivation gate), resulting in altered filter structure and suppression of ion permeation. Despite extensive studies, the detailed mechanism underlying the allosteric coupling between these two gating elements is not entirely understood. In this work, we investigate this question using extensive molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of multiple channels. We show that opening and closing of the central cavity simultaneously modulate cavity hydration level and the width of the selectivity filter entrance. Both structural features influence ion permeation rate. Cavity hydration reshapes the free energy of K(+) entry into the cavity. Crucially, the filter entrance size regulates ion occupancy at the selectivity filter, with maximal permeation occurring at an optimal size. Coupling between the filter entrance size and opening and closing of the central cavity is mediated by a hydrophobic residue on the inner transmembrane helix. Experimental structures from the Protein Data Bank also reveal state-dependent differences in the filter entrance size, thus establishing a direct link between experimental observations and our simulations. In summary, our results support a gating crosstalk model in which cavity hydration and the filter entrance size are coordinated to regulate ion permeation. This mechanism was consistently observed across six channels spanning several subfamilies, including MthK, cBK, TREK-2, KcsA, Kv4.2, and aBK, and may extend to other members of the K(+) channel family. 钾通道中的离子渗透受多个门控调控。特别是，中央空腔（激活门）的构象变化可以传播至选择性过滤器（失活门），导致过滤器结构改变并抑制离子渗透。尽管已有广泛研究，这两个门控元件之间变构偶联的详细机制尚未完全明了。在本工作中，我们利用多种通道的广泛分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来探究此问题。我们表明，中央空腔的开启和关闭同时调节空腔水合水平及选择性过滤器入口的宽度。这两个结构特征均影响离子渗透速率。空腔水合重塑了K(+)进入空腔的自由能。关键的是，过滤器入口尺寸调控选择性过滤器处的离子占据率，最大渗透发生在最佳尺寸时。过滤器入口尺寸与中央空腔开启和关闭之间的偶联由内跨膜螺旋上的一个疏水残基介导。来自蛋白质数据银行 (Protein Data Bank) 的实验结构也揭示了过滤器入口尺寸的状态依赖性差异，从而在实验观察与我们的模拟之间建立了直接联系。总之，我们的结果支持一种门控串扰模型，其中空腔水合和过滤器入口尺寸协同调节离子渗透。此机制在跨越多个亚家族的六种通道中一致观察到，包括MthK、cBK、TREK-2、KcsA、Kv4.2和aBK，并可能扩展至K(+)通道家族的其他成员。

documents.title: Structural Characterization and Engineering of a GH134 beta-Mannanase from Aspergillus nidulans for Enhancement of Activity and Stability.
meta: Chen, Sheng-Chia; Kuo, Po-Chih; Chen, Wen-Ming; Sheu, Shih-Yi; Huang, Yu-Bin; Huang, Cheng-Yang; Chien, I-Weh; Lee, Tzong-Huei; Hsu, Chun-Hua
Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
documents.summary: 该文通过晶体结构解析、对接、突变和分子动力学模拟表征并工程化改造一种β-甘露聚糖酶，虽涉及蛋白质结构计算（对接、MD），但核心是酶学性质优化，而非蛋白质结构预测、构象采样或通用结构计算方法创新，与本课题的蛋白质结构计算建模方向关联较弱。
documents.abstract: Mannans are abundant plant hemicelluloses, and endo-beta-mannanases are important biocatalysts for their conversion into functional manno-oligosaccharides. Here, we report the structural and functional characterization of a glycoside hydrolase family 134 beta-mannanase from Aspergillus nidulans (AnGH134) and a structure-guided engineering strategy to improve its performance on locust bean gum. The 1.75 A crystal structure reveals the conserved lysozyme-like fold of GH134 enzymes and supports an inverting catalytic mechanism with Glu43 and Asp55 as the putative catalytic residues. Docking, mutational, and molecular dynamics analyses indicate that AnGH134 uses an extended substrate-binding groove and that groove-exit residues and the C-terminal region contribute to productive catalysis. Guided by these findings, N-terminal fusion of CBM10 enhanced catalytic efficiency and thermal stability, whereas C-terminal fusion was detrimental. These results provide a framework for engineering GH134 mannanases. 甘露聚糖是丰富的植物半纤维素，内切-β-甘露聚糖酶是将其转化为功能性甘露寡糖的重要生物催化剂。本文报道了来自构巢曲霉（Aspergillus nidulans）的糖苷水解酶家族134 β-甘露聚糖酶（AnGH134）的结构与功能表征，以及一种基于结构导向的工程化策略，以提升其在刺槐豆胶上的性能。1.75 Å的晶体结构揭示了GH134酶保守的溶菌酶样折叠，并支持以Glu43和Asp55为假定催化残基的反转催化机制。对接、突变及分子动力学（molecular dynamics）分析表明，AnGH134利用一个延伸的底物结合沟槽，且沟槽出口残基及C端区域有助于高效催化。基于这些发现，N端融合CBM10增强了催化效率和热稳定性，而C端融合则产生不利影响。这些结果为工程化GH134甘露聚糖酶提供了框架。

documents.title: Hydrophobic Microenvironment Engineering Enhances Proton Transfer and Hydrolytic Activity of Zearalenone Lactonases.
